news.Title: Is Acquiring Aurora Cannabis a Good Move for Curaleaf?
news.Content:
Curaleaf Holdings (OTC: CURLF) has been aggressively pursuing Canadian-based cannabis producer Aurora Cannabis (NASDAQ: ACB) for well over a month. However, that hasn't been known to investors until recently, with Curaleaf now launching a hostile takeover attempt, as it claims Aurora hasn't been responding to its request for negotiation. "To date, Aurora has been unwilling to engage in constructive discussions," it states in its most recent press release.

Aurora Cannabis, however, has been a poor-performing stock, falling an incredible 95% over the past five years. It has struggled to generate much in the way of growth, and it's frequently in the red. Is this really a good move for Curaleaf?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What does Curaleaf like about Aurora?

Aurora has been a big name in the Canadian cannabis market , but that's not really why Curaleaf likes the business. The Canadian market is, after all, highly saturated and competitive. Canadian producers are eager to find other opportunities because the margins are so thin and it's hard to turn a profit.

Instead, it's Aurora's international presence that Curaleaf sees as a huge incentive to buy the business. The company sees this as an opportunity to expand its opportunities in international markets, particularly in Europe, where it notes that Aurora has "more than 50 tons of annual EU-GMP cultivation and manufacturing capacity." Curaleaf has three EU-GMP certified facilities, as it's been eyeing international cannabis markets as well.

Curaleaf estimates that through the acquisition, it could achieve $40 million worth of annual cost synergies by combining forces with Aurora. The combined business, it calculates, would have generated $1.5 billion in revenue over the past 12 months and $350 million in adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA).

Is this a good move for Curaleaf?

Curaleaf is a leading multi-state operator and has a strong business. Buying Aurora Cannabis at a beaten-down valuation could be an effective way for it to quickly expand into international markets; the offer comes out to approximately $272 million. There is risk with Aurora given its underwhelming financial results, but it has gotten leaner over the years. There may be some challenges, as there always is with acquisitions, but I believe it could be a good move for Curaleaf, in its efforts to build a strong international cannabis business.

Story Continues

Its stock has also struggled, nosediving 73% over the past five years, but that's largely due to the broader industrywide challenges that have been weighing on cannabis stocks due to the lack of movement toward legalization in the U.S.

While a deal with Aurora is by no means a certainty, this is a positive sign that Curaleaf is looking to expand internationally and grow its presence. For growth investors who are willing to be patient and are comfortable with taking on some risk, Curaleaf could be a suitable stock to buy and hold.

news.Title: Tesla files plans for proposed $10.1B Texas solar manufacturing plant
news.Content:
Tesla is planning to build a massive solar cell factory in Texas that it expects to cost $10.1 billion, according to documents the company filed with the state.

Dubbed Project Crystal Sun, the site would sit just outside Houston in Fort Bend County, according to the documents.

In its pitch to state regulators, Tesla said if Texas rejected the project, it would "miss the opportunity to attract billions of dollars in investment, help create thousands of full-time jobs for its residents and become a hub for domestic solar cell manufacturing in the U.S."

New Tesla Solar-powered Charging Station Opens

"Tesla is currently evaluating the feasibility of constructing its solar cell manufacturing facility at various locations across multiple U.S. states," the company told the state comptroller's office.

If built, the facility would create more than 9,700 permanent full-time jobs, as well as 1,147 temporary construction jobs, Tesla said.

Tesla plans to break ground on the factory this year and complete construction by 2028, with commercial operations expected to begin in 2029.

news.Title: IBM Landed A $240M AI Deal. Is That Enough?
news.Content:
IBM (NYSE: IBM ) just signed a $240 million deal with Together AI to build an Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA )-powered AI inference cluster on IBM Cloud, announced August 11. Together AI's chief revenue officer Kai Mak says demand is so strong the cluster will sell out two to three months before it even goes live. That kind of confidence from a partner is a good sign for a company whose shares have been under pressure this year. But a single deal, however sizable, still has to answer the bigger question: can IBM turn scattered growth pockets into a real growth story?

Bull Case: A Fresh Bet On AI Demand

The agreement covers an initial cluster built with roughly 2,000 Nvidia Blackwell 300 chips, using the HGX B300 systems and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking, located in the US. Together AI's platform lets businesses run open-source models like DeepSeek, MiniMax and Kimi more cheaply than closed alternatives, and the startup was valued at $8.3 billion in July. Mak told Reuters the company expects full offtake well before the cluster is ready for service, a sign that inference, not just training, is becoming a serious growth lever for IBM Cloud.

That momentum echoes what is already showing up in IBM's numbers. Software revenue rose 5% year-over-year in the most recent quarter, with Red Hat up 11%, the clearest evidence that IBM's shift toward higher-margin, recurring business lines is working. Longer term, CEO Arvind Krishna has said quantum computing could have a "measurable impact" on IBM's top and bottom lines as soon as 2028 or 2029, and he has pointed to the end of the 2030s as when that opportunity could be worth a trillion dollars. Add in a dividend raised for 31 straight years and covered about 2.5 times by expected free cash flow, and the long-term case has more legs than the stock price suggests.

Bear Case: The Growth Problem The Deal Doesn't Solve

None of that changes what happened in the quarter ended June 30, 2026: revenue grew just 1% to $17.2 billion, prompting IBM to cut its full-year guidance from more than 5% growth to a range of 4% to 5%. Consulting revenue was flat, infrastructure fell 7%, and the IBM Z mainframe line dropped 42%, the kind of decline that offsets a lot of AI headlines. Even the software growth investors lean on is decelerating, down from 11% growth in the prior quarter to 5% now. The dividend tells a similar story of caution: April's increase was a single penny per quarter, from $1.68 to $1.69, hardly the raise of a company brimming with confidence. Shares have fallen 33% from their 52-week high of $332.46, a slide that began after preliminary numbers badly missed expectations, and even after recovering some ground, the stock remains down 19% for the year.

Story Continues

What The Market Is Signaling

Hedge fund ownership fell from 63 funds to 59 in the most recent quarter, a modest pullback suggesting some institutional investors are trimming rather than piling in. Short interest sits at just 2.62% of float, which points to little organized skepticism about the stock. IBM trades at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 19.12 as of August 12, a multiple that assumes moderate growth rather than a rapid turnaround.

Where This Leaves Investors

The Together AI deal shows IBM Cloud can win real infrastructure business in the AI inference race, and the software segment and quantum roadmap give patient investors something to hold onto. Still, the mainframe decline, flat consulting revenue, and a guidance cut earlier this year show the core business isn't firing evenly yet.

While we acknowledge the potential of IBM as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Sandisk Could Be a Generational Buy at These Levels
news.Content:
Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) has been quite the stock in 2026. It rose nearly 900% from the start of the year to the end of June, but it has given up around half of those gains in the weeks since, which I think presents an incredible buying opportunity.

Few stocks have the upside potential that Sandisk has, and at any moment, a rally could send it back toward its all-time high.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The memory chip market will stay supply-constrained for years

Sandisk makes NAND memory chips, which are utilized for long-term data storage. The biggest use case for NAND memory is in solid-state drives, which are being deployed in huge quantities in data centers. Demand for NAND memory far exceeds supply, and because memory is a fairly commoditized industry with just a few major suppliers, the prices of all of their wares continue to rise.

The shortage and the resultant price surge were major factors in Sandisk's results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter (which ended July 3): One-third of its revenue growth in the period came from increased sales volumes, and two-thirds came from higher pricing. Altogether, Sandisk's revenue surged by 372% in its fiscal Q4.

Wall Street analysts expect a similar performance for Q1 fiscal 2027 -- revenue is forecast to rise over 360% year over year. However, throughout fiscal 2027, the company's top-line growth is expected to moderate, with 140% revenue growth expected. That's still quite impressive, and it isn't really being priced into the stock at all.

Sandisk trades now for just 5.8 times expected forward earnings.

That's a cheap valuation, and it reflects the fact that the market is skeptical about the longer-term outlook for the memory chip market. The primary concern is that once more supply is added -- and all of the major memory companies are expanding production capacity -- conditions will shift from a shortage to a glut and prices will crash, dragging down Sandisk's margins and its business. While that's a reasonable concern, it ignores a real possibility: What if the high demand from AI hyperscalers building new data centers continues to eat up the increased supply?

It's well documented that insufficient memory supply is now the chief bottleneck limiting the pace of AI data center development; once that issue is resolved, AI computing capacity could be built out at a faster rate . However, nobody knows what will happen to pricing. The higher sales volumes possible with increased supply may make up for the possibility of falling prices, in which case, memory chip stocks like Sandisk would remain strong investments. I think this possibility is being underappreciated by the market, which is why I think Sandisk stock could be a generational buy right now , as it's trading at such a cheap valuation that it's nearly impossible to ignore.

news.Title: SpaceX Has Slumped Since Its Debut. Here Is Where History Says the Stock Heads Next.
news.Content:
SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX), the aerospace and AI company founded by Elon Musk, went public at $135 per share on June 12. Its stock closed at a record high of $211.39 on June 16, but it now trades at about $140. Let's see why it slumped -- and where it might be headed.

Why did SpaceX's stock soar and sink?

A low float (it offered less than 5% of its shares) and market hype drove SpaceX's initial rally. But at its peak, SpaceX's market cap hit $2.64 trillion -- or 141 times the $18.7 billion in revenue it generated in 2025. Even though its revenue rose 33% in 2025, its sky-high valuation was unsustainable. As the euphoria from its IPO faded, investors fretted over its steep losses and aggressive spending plans -- and its stock crumbled under the weight of its lofty valuations.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

SpaceX's hasty takeover of xAI (which houses Grok, X, and its other AI assets) right before its IPO also raised red flags. Before that acquisition, SpaceX generated a slim profit as Starlink's profits offset its launch service segment's losses. But after that acquisition, the losses from its AI and space divisions wiped out Starlink's profits. That pressure will intensify for the foreseeable future as SpaceX ramps up its AI-driven investments and acquisitions.

Musk claims SpaceX can generate more than $1 trillion in annual revenue by 2030, but its space, satellite, and AI businesses would need to grow much larger to hit that target. For now, analysts expect its revenue to grow to $155 billion by 2028. That's an impressive 5-year CAGR of 103% from 2025, but it would need much bigger catalysts to reach $1 trillion by 2030.

Where will SpaceX's stock head next?

With a market cap of $1.76 trillion, SpaceX trades at 39 times this year's sales. That price-to-sales ratio is still high, but it doesn't look as overheated as it did in mid-June.

However, SpaceX's valuation -- along with its upcoming lockup expirations through the end of the year -- should limit its near-term gains. Many other hot IPOs -- including Meta , Alibaba , and Snowflake -- faced similar pullbacks after their widely hyped market debuts.

While it might be tempting to buy SpaceX as it revisits its IPO price, it could sink even lower if the market crashes or the company fails to meet Wall Street's sky-high expectations. Therefore, the history of other hot IPOs suggests we shouldn't rush to buy SpaceX's stock right now.

news.Title: Bloom Energy Says It's Now "The Standard for AI Onsite Power." Here's What That Means for the Stock.
news.Content:
Investors should take any publicly traded company's self-congratulating comments with a grain of salt. Such cheerleading is usually just an attempt to cast a more bullish light on its stock.

Just because a statement has a self-serving agenda, however, doesn't mean it's inaccurate.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

It's an issue that current or prospective Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) shareholders are wrestling with right now. Within its recent Q2 report, CEO KR Sridhar said, "Today, all the major U.S. hyperscalers and over a dozen U.S. neoclouds, AI labs, and colocation data center operators have validated and approved our power solutions for their AI factories." His conclusion? "Bloom is now a standard for AI onsite power." Maybe it is. Revenue grew 165.5% year over year to $1.06 billion during the three months in question, after all.

The question is, what might it mean for Bloom's stock?

But first things first.

Bloom Energy is in the right business at the right time

Simply put, Bloom is mainstreaming a new way of producing electricity when and where it's needed. In contrast with combustion-powered generators or natural gas-powered turbines, Bloom Energy makes and markets so-called fuel cells that convert a gas -- usually hydrogen -- directly into electricity using an electrochemical rather than a mechanical process. The key is the catalytic material found within the equipment itself.

Even by fuel cell standards, however, Bloom Energy is a standout. Its solid oxide fuel cell technology is capable of converting hydrogen, natural gas, or even biogas into electricity, providing facilities of all sizes (including artificial intelligence data centers) the flexibility their owners want when taking power production into their own hands .

It's working too. Plenty of institutions are buying Bloom's tech, including Oracle for its AI data centers. In April, the technology giant more than doubled the amount of electricity it asked of Bloom Energy, from 1.2 gigawatts to 2.8 gigawatts.

This is still just the beginning, too. Now that the tech is proving a viable alternative to more mainstream options, industry research outfit Technavio expects the worldwide fuel cell market to grow at an average annualized pace of nearly 40% between now and 2030.

Not actually the standard, but certainly mainstream enough

Story Continues

But are Bloom's solutions truly "the Standard for AI Onsite Power?" Not quite.

Although it's clearly increasingly popular, globally, the International Energy Administration reports coal and conventional use of natural gas (burning it to spin power turbines) remain the top two power sources for the world's AI data centers, and even the two of them combined only account for a little over half of the electricity these facilities consume. Natural gas is proving to be an increasingly popular option within the United States, though, which is the world's single-biggest operator of AI data centers, and where Bloom is located and therefore well positioned to serve.

As for what it means for the stock, despite this ticker's subpar performance since mid-June, the analyst community arguably has this one right. Their consensus 12-month target of $279.07 is 30% above the stock's present price.

The near-tripling of per-share earnings that analysts expect between this year and 2028, however, also makes this ticker an undervalued longer-term prospect even if its solid oxide fuel cells aren't actually the AI industry's new overarching standard for onsite power.

news.Title: Why Quantinuum Stock Popped Today
news.Content:
When pure-play quantum computing stock Quantinuum (NASDAQ: QNT) stock made its Nasdaq debut two months ago, the stock -- which technically IPO'ed at $60 a share -- actually began trading at $68 a share.

Today, it's back at $68 once again, its stock price up 24.1% as of 1:55 p.m. ET -- and earnings are the reason.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Quantinuum Q2 earnings

Quantinuum stock soared as high as $86 a share in the first month after its IPO -- a gain of as much as 43% over its nominal IPO price -- before falling below $50 per share (a loss of more than 20%) as investors turned risk-averse in late July. Now that we finally have some earnings to examine, though, investors may find more solid reasons to want to buy (or sell) Quantinuum stock.

So what did Quantinuum report last night?

Sales growth for one thing. Q2 sales grew 279% year over year to $8 million. Losses for another -- Quantinuum booked a $596.5 million net loss for the quarter -- more than ten times its year-ago loss.

What's next for Quantinuum stock

On the plus side, cash burn was less extreme. So far this year, Quantinuum has burned "only" $168.3 million. That still leaves the company $2.1 billion in the bank after its big IPO payday.

While the bad news is that analysts expect Quantinuum to continue burning cash, and indeed to run through roughly $1 billion over the next couple of years, the good news is that Quantinuum appears to have more than enough cash to pay for this -- and perhaps to emerge on the other side, free cash flow-positive and finally self-funding, in 2030.

Fingers crossed.

news.Title: Amazon (AMZN) Is Powering OpenAI’s Cyber Models, So Why Is The Stock So Cheap?
news.Content:
Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ) just gave security teams a fresh reason to watch its cloud business. On August 11, two specialized cybersecurity models from OpenAI, Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue, went live on Amazon Bedrock for eligible customers, and AWS's own security teams are already using them to find and fix vulnerabilities faster. It's the latest step in a partnership that keeps expanding, and it lands just as investors are debating whether Amazon's spending spree will pay off.

Bull Case: AWS Is Quietly Becoming An AI Machine

The Daybreak launch caps months of buildout. Earlier on April 28, Amazon and OpenAI announced a major expansion of their partnership, bringing OpenAI models, the Codex coding agent, and Bedrock Managed Agents to AWS in limited preview, wrapped in the enterprise controls big customers already use, including IAM access management, AWS PrivateLink, and CloudTrail logging. By July 9, GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna reached general availability on Bedrock, with Terra priced at half the cost of GPT-5.5 and a 90% discount on cached inputs. Codex already has more than 4 million weekly users, and now it runs inside the AWS environments those customers already operate at scale.

The financial results back up the momentum. AWS revenue grew 37% year-over-year last quarter, the fifth straight quarter of acceleration and the fastest pace in 18 quarters, even though the business has doubled in size over that stretch. Amazon's AI services and its custom chip lineup, Trainium, Inferentia, and Graviton, each crossed a $25 billion annualized run rate and are both growing at triple-digit rates. Behind that sits $496 billion in contracted revenue, including deals to supply OpenAI with 2 gigawatts of Trainium capacity and Anthropic with up to 5 gigawatts of Trainium and Graviton over a 10-year agreement. Retail is contributing too, with advertising revenue up 26% year over year and online store sales up 15%.

Bear Case: Building That Much Infrastructure Isn't Free

Amazon now plans to spend $220 billion on capex this year, up from a $200 billion estimate just one quarter earlier and well above the $132 billion it spent in 2025. Part of that increase traces to memory chip prices, which have spiked amid a shortage. The spending has pushed free cash flow to negative $7.6 billion over the trailing 12 months, a sharp reversal from the positive $18.2 billion generated a year earlier, and long-term debt has climbed 96% to nearly $129 billion.

That kind of spending increase leaves less room for error if it doesn't convert into earnings growth. The bigger risk isn't that Amazon or its AI partners can't pay their bills; it's that hyperscalers collectively build more data center capacity than the market needs, which would pressure pricing industry-wide. Amazon does have some flexibility here, since server orders typically carry a lead time of just a few months and a payback period under three years. Jeff Bezos also sold more than $4 billion worth of shares, a transaction reportedly planned eight months, though the timing still rattled some investors.

Story Continues

Wall Street's Mixed Signals

Hedge fund ownership dropped from 381 funds to 353 in the most recent quarter, a pullback suggesting some institutional holders trimmed their positions. Short interest, by contrast, sits at just 1% of the float, showing little organized skepticism toward the stock. As of August 12, Amazon trades at 23.70 times forward earnings, a multiple that assumes real profit growth ahead. Put those signals together, and the picture is mixed: funds pulling back even as short sellers stay away and the market keeps paying a premium.

Where This Leaves Amazon Investors

Amazon's cloud business is accelerating at a pace it hasn't shown in years, and the OpenAI partnership adds another lever as enterprises adopt AI tools. That growth is coming at a cost, with capital spending pushing free cash flow sharply negative and debt climbing quickly. The newer AI and chip segments becoming real revenue contributors is the clearest sign the investment is starting to pay off.

While we acknowledge the potential of AMZN as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 台股在虛漲？前政府基金操盤手示警「大盤會打第2隻腳」：持股上限鎖在5成
news.Content:
前政府基金操盤手 黃豐凱 表示，預期大盤後續會再回撤、打第2隻腳，此時盤勢切勿再往上漲時盲目追價。示意圖。（資料照，顏麟宇攝）

台股12日漲397.35點，收在4萬5518.07點，成交值新台幣8587.32億元。三大法人外資及陸資、投信、自營商同步買超，合計買超225.22億元。對此，前政府基金操盤手黃豐凱12日在節目《財經一路發》上表示，當前盤勢雖然站回季線，但老手卻不敢買。

黃豐凱表示，大盤與櫃買的月線目前都沒有勾起來，技術面上彎才具實質支撐，此時上漲屬於缺乏下檔防護的虛漲，最強的AI主線並未全面暴動，資金反而擴散到腳踏車、上銀等非AI板塊。

黃豐凱：頸線一跌破，多頭架構就會破壞​

黃豐凱表示，這是因為主力只敢挑「財報數字有把握」的個股短打，散戶又都在上一波融資斷頭潮被大幅清洗出場，預期大盤後續會再回撤、打第2隻腳，此時盤勢切勿再往上漲時盲目追價，操作必須極度謹慎。目前大盤剛過頸線，一旦跌破，多頭架構就會破壞，持股上限建議鎖在5成。

黃豐凱提到，外資買超力積電等個股與矽電容及愛普的IP趨勢有關，外資法人買的加減看就好，應該瞄準被政府「處置交易」牽連的委屈標的，如基本面紮實、數字漂亮，卻被關到第2次處置才放出來，股價相對落後大盤的禾伸堂。未來必須將反向指標放在心裡，用周線宏觀監控，一旦突破周大量高點，現股再強也必須立刻戴上鋼盔避險，絕不赤裸迎接風暴。​

news.Title: Airbnb vs. PepsiCo: Which Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
Should you prioritize the high-growth potential of the digital travel economy or the steady dividends of a global snack titan? Investors choosing between Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) and PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) are weighing two very different paths to wealth.

Airbnb operates a massive online marketplace for stays and local experiences, while PepsiCo produces iconic food and beverage brands found in almost every pantry. Comparing these two giants helps you decide if you prefer a lean, tech-driven platform or a diversified consumer manufacturing powerhouse with a long history of dividends.

The case for Airbnb

Airbnb operates as a leader among consumer discretionary stocks by providing a global marketplace for stays and local experiences. The company connects over five million hosts with guests while utilizing infrastructure from Amazon and Alphabet to run its platform. It also manages complex payment integrations to support transactions in approximately 50 different currencies worldwide.

In FY 2025, revenue reached nearly $12.2 billion, which was an increase of approximately 10.3% compared to the previous year. The company generated a net income of roughly $2.5 billion for the period. This resulted in a net margin of close to 20.5%, reflecting the platform's ability to turn a significant portion of its sales into profit.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was approximately 0.3x. This ratio compares total debt, including short-term and long-term obligations, to shareholder equity, suggesting the company uses relatively little debt to fund its operations. Free cash flow was approximately $4.6 billion, though note that stock-based compensation represented roughly 34.3% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

The case for PepsiCo

PepsiCo is a global giant in the beverage and snack markets with brands like Lay's and Gatorade. Its customer base spans wholesale distributors, grocery stores, and massive retailers like Walmart . Notably, Walmart represents a major customer concentration, accounting for nearly 14% of total revenue in 2025, and customer concentration like this adds a layer of risk to the business.

In FY 2025, revenue reached nearly $93.9 billion, representing a growth of roughly 2.3% over the prior year. The company reported a net income of approximately $8.2 billion. This led to a net margin of nearly 8.8%, reflecting the higher costs associated with manufacturing and distributing physical goods compared to digital platforms.

Story Continues

As of the December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was approximately 2.4x, indicating the company carries more debt than the value of its shareholder equity. The current ratio was close to 0.9x, indicating that its short-term liabilities slightly exceed its most liquid assets. Free cash flow reached nearly $7.7 billion for the fiscal year, providing significant capital for dividends and business reinvestment.

Risk profile comparison

Airbnb faces significant regulatory hurdles as various cities implement strict rules or outright bans on short-term rentals. The company is also involved in a major tax dispute with the IRS involving a $1.3 billion notice regarding the valuation of international intellectual property. Furthermore, the business relies heavily on third-party infrastructure from Amazon and Alphabet , which could lead to service disruptions if those partnerships face technical or contractual issues.

PepsiCo must navigate increasing government taxes on sugar-sweetened drinks and evolving environmental rules for plastic packaging. It faces intense competition from global rivals like The Coca-Cola Company , as well as cheaper private-label brands that pressure its pricing power. Additionally, the company is managing various legal challenges, including antitrust litigation and lawsuits related to the health profile of its snack products in the eyes of consumers and massive retailers like Walmart.

Valuation comparison

PepsiCo appears significantly cheaper based on its earnings multiples, while Airbnb commands a higher premium for its growth potential. The Forward P/E measures price against future earnings estimates, while the P/S ratio compares market value to total revenue. Valuation metrics indicate that investors are paying more for each dollar of sales at Airbnb.

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

I'd go with Airbnb. That said, PepsiCo is a household name with a dividend history that income-focused investors have counted on for decades, and that stability has value. International demand for its snacks and beverages is holding up well, and the company reaffirmed its full-year guidance in its most recent quarter.

But PepsiCo is dealing with a soft patch that is hard to overlook. North American consumers are pulling back on discretionary snack spending as gas prices and inflation squeeze household budgets, and the company signaled that full-year earnings may come in toward the lower end of its guidance range. For a stock that investors typically buy for steady, predictable returns, that cautious tone is not encouraging.

Airbnb, by contrast, is a company in good shape. Revenue grew at a healthy pace in the most recent quarter, free cash flow is substantial, and global travel demand is holding up well. The platform has a loyal, growing user base and a business model that keeps getting more efficient as it scales.

If you're a long-term investor looking for growth, Airbnb is the more exciting place to put your money right now.

news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL , Financials ), the parent of Google, said its Gemini app has surpassed 1 billion monthly users, giving the company another major milestone in its race against OpenAI.

Is GOOGL fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

CEO Sundar Pichai called Gemini Google's fastest-growing product ever and the 14th company product to cross the 1 billion-user mark.

That scale matters because the AI race is increasingly moving from attracting users to figuring out how to make money from them.

OpenAI recently said its models also reach more than 1 billion active users and has been expanding advertising inside ChatGPT into additional international markets.

Google already owns one of the world's largest advertising businesses, potentially giving it an advantage if it can connect Gemini usage with its broader ecosystem without hurting the user experience.

Gemini also benefits from Google's reach across Android, Search, Workspace and other products.

The milestone does not by itself tell investors how profitable Gemini will become.

But with 1 billion users now in place, the bigger question is shifting from whether Google can compete in consumer AI to how much money that audience can eventually generate.

Chicago, IL – August 12, 2026 – Today, Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights Space Exploration Technologies SPCX, Meta Platforms META, Palantir PLTR, Snowflake SNOW, Alphabet GOOGL, AT&T T and T-Mobile TMUS.

Beyond Space: AI Compute & Starlink Drive SpaceX Growth

The Average IPO Corrects Roughly 50%

Earlier this year, Space Exploration Technologies became the largest initial public offering (IPO) in history with a valuation near $2 trillion. Despite SpaceX's size, its near-monopoly in its industry, and being one of the most hyped IPOs ever, shares fell from a high of $225.78 to a low of $105.62. History teaches investors that such corrections are the norm. In fact, within one year of its debut, the average tech IPO sees a drawdown of 55% from its peak. SpaceX just witnessed a 53% drawdown.

Whether it was due to psychology or mispricing, the correction in SpaceX shares is no surprise to seasoned investors. In fact, long-term market winners like Meta Platforms , Palantir and Snowflake all suffered 50% drawdowns early on before beginning their uptrends.

SpaceX Earnings & Guidance Impress

Last week, SpaceX delivered earnings that beat Wall Street expectations. Revenue jumped 92% year-over-year to $7.8 billion while net losses narrowed to $143 million versus $541 million. EPS of -$0.09 beat Zacks Consensus Estimates by a juicy 65.38%.

However, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk's guidance was even more intriguing. Musk now expects SpaceX to reach $1 trillion in revenue by 2030 with a "non-zero" chance of reaching it in 2029. Additionally, Musk expects annual recurring revenue (ARR) to explode to $100 billion by year-end (up from a $10.4 billion run rate in June).

xAI Segment is on Fire

Although SpaceX is known for being a space company, its fastest-growing business segment is AI hardware. Top-line growth is being driven by lucrative contracts from AI giants Alphabet and Anthropic. Compute revenue reached $2.6 billion (+247% YoY). Meanwhile, in the earnings call, management projected that SpaceX is now targeting 10 gigawatts (GW) of compute for 2027. Currently, SpaceX has ~1GW of compute.

Starlink is Disrupting the Telecom Space

Starlink, SpaceX's satellite internet service, is also experiencing rapid growth. Connectivity revenue reached $4.3 billion, up 66% year-over-year, while subscribers doubled year-over-year to 12 million. On the earnings call, Musk highlighted the company's V3 satellite, saying:

"Starlink V3 satellite is about an order of magnitude more capable than the Starlink V2...even if our monetization per bit dropped by a factor of 10, that would still mean a 10x increase in the revenue of Starlink."

Story Continues

Meanwhile, Starlink is expanding beyond remote home broadband to higher average revenue per user (ARPU) businesses like enterprise, aviation, maritime, and defense. Also, Starlink will be unveiling a direct-to-cell mobile connectivity service to take on legacy telecom companies like AT&T and T-Mobile .

Starship is a Massive Catalyst

Starship is SpaceX's game-changing rocket, currently in testing, and the largest flying manmade object. In July, Starship's 13th test flight achieved several monumental firsts including:

· Heatshield Success: Starship's heat shield survived atmospheric reentry entirely intact for the first time.

· Satellite Deployment: Starship successfully deployed 20 next-gen Starlink V3 satellites in orbit.

· Reusability: The Super Heavy booster achieved a controlled descent (although it had a hard splashdown), getting the Starship one step closer to reusability.

Starship will have its next test soon. Once Starship is up and running it will be able to deliver up to 300 metric tons to space (~5x more than its Falcon 9 rocket).

CAPEX Normalization

Like many big tech companies, SpaceX's capital expenditures soared. CAPEX grew more than 600% to $18.37 billion. However, as the hyper-aggressive CAPEX cycle (driven by AI buildouts and Starship R&D) normalizes, free cash flow generation will explode.

Bottom line

Driven by explosive growth in non-traditional segments like AI compute hardware and Starlink, SpaceX is laying the groundwork for unprecedented scale.

news.Title: Analog Devices (ADI) Earnings Expected to Grow: Should You Buy?
news.Content:
Wall Street expects a year-over-year increase in earnings on higher revenues when Analog Devices (ADI) reports results for the quarter ended July 2026. While this widely-known consensus outlook is important in gauging the company's earnings picture, a powerful factor that could impact its near-term stock price is how the actual results compare to these estimates.

The earnings report, which is expected to be released on August 19, might help the stock move higher if these key numbers are better than expectations. On the other hand, if they miss, the stock may move lower.

While management's discussion of business conditions on the earnings call will mostly determine the sustainability of the immediate price change and future earnings expectations, it's worth having a handicapping insight into the odds of a positive EPS surprise.

Zacks Consensus Estimate

This semiconductor maker is expected to post quarterly earnings of $3.33 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +62.4%.

Revenues are expected to be $3.92 billion, up 36.3% from the year-ago quarter.

Estimate Revisions Trend

The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has been revised 1.78% higher over the last 30 days to the current level. This is essentially a reflection of how the covering analysts have collectively reassessed their initial estimates over this period.

Investors should keep in mind that an aggregate change may not always reflect the direction of estimate revisions by each of the covering analysts.

Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Earnings Whisper

Estimate revisions ahead of a company's earnings release offer clues to the business conditions for the period whose results are coming out. This insight is at the core of our proprietary surprise prediction model -- the Zacks Earnings ESP (Expected Surprise Prediction).

The Zacks Earnings ESP compares the Most Accurate Estimate to the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the quarter; the Most Accurate Estimate is a more recent version of the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate. The idea here is that analysts revising their estimates right before an earnings release have the latest information, which could potentially be more accurate than what they and others contributing to the consensus had predicted earlier.

Thus, a positive or negative Earnings ESP reading theoretically indicates the likely deviation of the actual earnings from the consensus estimate. However, the model's predictive power is significant for positive ESP readings only.

Story Continues

A positive Earnings ESP is a strong predictor of an earnings beat, particularly when combined with a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), 2 (Buy) or 3 (Hold). Our research shows that stocks with this combination produce a positive surprise nearly 70% of the time, and a solid Zacks Rank actually increases the predictive power of Earnings ESP.

Please note that a negative Earnings ESP reading is not indicative of an earnings miss. Our research shows that it is difficult to predict an earnings beat with any degree of confidence for stocks with negative Earnings ESP readings and/or Zacks Rank of 4 (Sell) or 5 (Strong Sell).

How Have the Numbers Shaped Up for Analog Devices?

For Analog Devices, the Most Accurate Estimate is higher than the Zacks Consensus Estimate, suggesting that analysts have recently become bullish on the company's earnings prospects. This has resulted in an Earnings ESP of +2.37%.

On the other hand, the stock currently carries a Zacks Rank of #2.

So, this combination indicates that Analog Devices will most likely beat the consensus EPS estimate.

Does Earnings Surprise History Hold Any Clue?

While calculating estimates for a company's future earnings, analysts often consider to what extent it has been able to match past consensus estimates. So, it's worth taking a look at the surprise history for gauging its influence on the upcoming number.

For the last reported quarter, it was expected that Analog Devices would post earnings of $2.89 per share when it actually produced earnings of $3.09, delivering a surprise of +6.92%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has beaten consensus EPS estimates four times.

Bottom Line

An earnings beat or miss may not be the sole basis for a stock moving higher or lower. Many stocks end up losing ground despite an earnings beat due to other factors that disappoint investors. Similarly, unforeseen catalysts help a number of stocks gain despite an earnings miss.

That said, betting on stocks that are expected to beat earnings expectations does increase the odds of success. This is why it's worth checking a company's Earnings ESP and Zacks Rank ahead of its quarterly release. Make sure to utilize our Earnings ESP Filter to uncover the best stocks to buy or sell before they've reported.

Analog Devices appears a compelling earnings-beat candidate. However, investors should pay attention to other factors too for betting on this stock or staying away from it ahead of its earnings release.

news.Title: Can Sandisk's Strong Cash Generation Boost Shareholder Returns?
news.Content:
Sandisk Corporation SNDK is building a more durable cash-generating franchise in the memory industry, creating scope for stronger shareholder returns. The improvement is being supported by higher pricing, a rapid shift toward data centers and increasing operating leverage. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Sandisk generated $7.13 billion in cash flow from operations and $5.04 billion in adjusted free cash flow, representing a 56% margin.

The key driver is Sandisk's growing exposure to Datacenter, its fastest-growing end market. Datacenter revenues surged 103% sequentially to $2.98 billion and represented 38% of the portfolio exiting fiscal 2026, up from roughly 12% a year earlier. This shift is being reinforced by New Business Model agreements with eight Datacenter and Edge customers, carrying a weighted average duration exceeding four years and minimum expected revenues of $93.9 billion at floor pricing. These agreements are expected to represent more than 50% of bit shipments in fiscal 2027 and roughly two-thirds in fiscal 2028, improving the predictability of cash generation and reducing exposure to spot market volatility.

The stronger cash profile is enabling substantial capital returns. Sandisk repurchased $4.5 billion of shares in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 and authorized an additional $14 billion buyback, taking total remaining authorization to $15.5 billion. This scale provides meaningful scope for further per-share value creation as cash generation continues.

AI-driven storage demand, continued pricing strength and the ramp of BiCS 8 and BiCS 10 should support further growth ahead. Capital spending is expected to rise but remain near 6% of fiscal 2027 revenue, preserving capital efficiency and giving Sandisk room to keep returning excess cash to shareholders.

How SNDK's Peers Are Positioned

Sandisk's close peers Seagate Technology STX and Western Digital WDC are also benefiting from stronger cash generation, supporting capital returns. Seagate Technology generated $1.1 billion in free cash flow in the fiscal fourth quarter and returned $283 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases. Western Digital generated $1.28 billion in free cash flow during the same period and repurchased $672 million of shares while paying $54 million in dividends. As Seagate Technology and Western Digital continue to generate robust cash flows, their shareholder-return capacity remains supported. For SNDK, its higher free cash flow generation and disciplined capital spending could provide greater room for buybacks.

Story Continues

news.Title: Google launches Pixel 11 smartphone line, including Pixel 11 Pro Fold, as Apple preps foldable iPhone
news.Content:
Google ( GOOG , GOOGL ) debuted its latest line of Pixel smartphones on Wednesday, including the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and the foldable Pixel 11 Pro Fold.

The devices come as Apple ( AAPL ) prepares to unveil its iPhone 18 lineup and rumored first foldable iPhone next month. They're also landing as smartphone makers are contending with the ongoing AI-driven memory and storage shortage driving up component costs.

Each of the Pixel phones gets a $100 price increase, though the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro also get more starting storage.

Samsung ( 005930.KS ) has also increased the cost of its Android-based smartphones, and Apple is widely expected to do the same next month.

Google's smartphones aren't volume sellers. The company doesn't break out revenue from unit sales, and instead nests it under its Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices segment.

According to Counterpoint Research , Google captured just 3% of the US market share in Q1 2026. Samsung grabbed 26%, while Apple had 58% of the market.

But the phones do serve as an idealized version of what a Google smartphone could be. The Pixel lineup also provides a gateway for hardcore Google fans to take advantage of the company's Gemini AI platform and other services.

From a design standpoint, the Pixel 11 family carries over the same styling as the Pixel 10 lineup.

All four phones get three rear cameras and Google's latest Tensor G6 processor. The Pixel 11 sports 12GB of memory, while the 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL get your choice of 12GB or 16GB of memory and between 256GB and 1TB of storage.

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold gets 16GB of memory and between 256GB and 1TB of storage.

Google says the Pixel 11's Gemini Intelligence services can perform certain agentic tasks, such as booking you a ride and ordering groceries on its own.

The phones are also context-aware, with Google saying they will surface the information you need when you need it. According to the company, this includes things like pulling up your calendar availability when someone asks you to grab dinner via text.

In addition to the Pixel 11 line, Google unveiled its Pixel Watch 5, which the company says can now help users track their blood pressure and insulin resistance.

Google, however, notes that the features aren't meant to diagnose or treat medical conditions, making them more of a kind of advisory tool.

news.Title: Will CoreWeave's Global Expansion Accelerate Revenue Growth?
news.Content:
CoreWeave, Inc. CRWV is expanding its global infrastructure as demand for AI cloud services continues to strengthen across sectors, geographies and workloads. In the second quarter of 2026, the company generated record revenue of $2.6 billion, up 112% year over year, while its revenue backlog reached $104.2 billion. CoreWeave also added more than $25 billion of net new customer commitments in the early weeks of the third quarter. The company ended the second quarter with 1.5 gigawatts of active power and remains on track to reach at least 8 gigawatts by 2030.

Global expansion is becoming an important part of this capacity strategy. CoreWeave said it has contracted more than 1 gigawatt of power outside the United States and recently entered the Asia-Pacific region with 360 megawatts in Indonesia. This capacity is expected to come online in approximately 18 months. The company expects international markets to become a major driver of growth as it meets customers where they and their end users operate. On the last earnings call, CoreWeave highlighted that demand is expected to meaningfully exceed supply for years, supporting the need for continued investment in infrastructure, power and supply-chain capacity.

The company is also expanding beyond its core cloud infrastructure through managed inference, storage, CPU, networking and software. Its margin-accretive businesses beyond GPUs exceeded $400 million in annualized recurring revenue in the second quarter, while managed inference booked ARR increased from $1 million to more than $100 million within a few months. CoreWeave expects to exit 2026 with at least $250 million of managed inference ARR. These offerings are being adopted by a broader customer base and provide additional ways for customers to expand their spending on the platform.

CoreWeave raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $12.4 billion-$13.2 billion and expects year-end annualized run-rate revenue of $18.5 billion-$19.5 billion. With more than 1 gigawatt of international power contracted, including the Indonesia expansion, the company expects global markets to contribute meaningfully to future growth as it continues expanding capacity and serving customers worldwide.

Taking a Look at CRWV's Competitors

Microsoft Corporation MSFT reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenues of $90 billion, which increased 18% year over year. At constant currency, revenues grew 17% year over year, reflecting continued strength in cloud and AI demand. For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Microsoft expects total company revenues between $89.85 billion and $90.95 billion, suggesting growth of roughly 16% to 17%. The Intelligent Cloud segment is expected to generate revenues between $40.95 billion and $41.25 billion. The Productivity and Business Processes segment is expected to generate revenues between $36.7 billion and $37.0 billion.

Story Continues

Amazon.com Inc. AMZN reported second-quarter 2026 net sales of $200.6 billion, up 20% year over year. Amazon's international expansion and diversification across e-commerce, AWS cloud services, advertising and streaming create multiple revenue streams while reducing concentration risk. For the third quarter of 2026, Amazon expects net sales between $197 billion and $202 billion, indicating growth of 9% to 12% compared with the third quarter of 2025. AI integration across operations enhances personalization, logistics and AWS offerings, strengthening competitive positioning.

CRWV Price Performance, Valuation and Estimates

Shares of CoreWeave have lost 18.9% in the past three months against the Internet Software industry's growth of 15.2%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

In terms of Price/Book, CRWV's shares are trading at 8.49X, higher than the Internet Software Services industry's 5.07X.

news.Title: 輝達攜金融巨頭擴AI融資引疑慮 分析師：投資回報成關鍵
news.Content:
輝達攜手六大金融機構，目標引入逾5000億美元第三方資金投入 AI 基礎設施。分析師認為，融資平台有助降低業者取得AI基建資金的門檻，至於是否形成泡沫，關鍵仍在AI需求能否持續，以及龐大投資能否轉化為實際收益。若觀察美股第二季財報，已陸續將投資轉化為業績與收益，AI產業前景仍正向。

輝達宣布攜手阿波羅、貝萊德、黑石等六大金融機構，成立獨立運算融資平台，目標引入逾5000億美元第三方資金投入AI基礎設施。透過新的融資模式，輝達目標透過將AI基礎設施轉化為可投資資產，擴大AI工廠建置，並帶動硬體銷售及軟體生態系成長。

輝達執行長黃仁勳透過新聞稿指出，輝達正從晶片供應商，進一步協助打造具生產力、可投資的「AI工廠」基礎設施。透過與全球主要長期資本供應商合作，將協助客戶大規模取得運算資源、建置DSX AI工廠，為各產業及國家的AI發展提供運算能力。

分析師蔡明翰表示，建立融資平台延續輝達的營運策略。隨著市場看好AI發展前景，各方積極擴大投資，但不同業者的資金與融資能力存在明顯差距，對於融資成本較高的企業，可望透過輝達引入金融機構資金，降低AI基礎設施的融資門檻與資金成本。他說：『(原音)大型的他不用去考量，四大雲端業者自己有錢，而且以他們的地位可以拿到非常低成本的資金。要籌這些大資金讓人家借，主要就是一些借錢不是這麼容易，或是相對成本比較高的。由他幫忙出面相對來講比較容易，成本相對比較低。』

他認為，市場對這類融資模式仍有疑慮，擔心形成「AI永動機」，透過提供給客戶資金，再用於採購AI設備，若槓桿過高，可能增加未來泡沫化風險。不過，關鍵仍在於「AI需求能否穩健成長」，以及相關投資是否能轉化為「實際收益」。

蔡明翰進一步分析，從美股第二季財報來看，許多企業的AI投資已逐步轉化為營收與獲利，顯示AI發展並非僅停留在題材炒作。若企業投入的資本能持續創造回報，相關投資仍具支撐，當企業願意擴大投入，也反映對未來AI業務成長抱持正面看法。

他認為，只要AI需求持續存在，且資金能轉化為收益，就不必過度悲觀看待AI資本支出擴張。過去市場多次因擔憂AI資本支出過高而出現短線修正，但隨後基本面持續成長，反而成為較佳的投資布局時點。(編輯：鍾錦隆)

news.AI_Summary:

news.Content:
台股在歷經震撼大跌過後，指數出現反彈契機，投資贏家們在此分享，如何在汰弱換強、掌握獲利勝算的同時，又能避開風險誤區的操作策略。

台股經歷「去槓桿」大幅修正之後逐漸回魂，雖然第三季預料仍以整理格局居多，但部分投資贏家已開始盤點此際值得先行鎖定、伺機布局的私房標的。

「一個月的大跌（7月）、兩個月整理（8至9月）、三個月的多頭。」有產業隊長之稱的張捷，以此定調後續盤勢。他認為，在市場籌碼趨於沉澱後，9月底中秋節後有機會轉折向上，即使屆時出現美國聯準會升息干擾，短線不排除再次探底，但預料仍是大盤重啟多頭的前奏。籌碼贏家郭勝亦認為，第三季台股指數預料約在3萬8千點至4萬6千點箱型整理，但第四季後大盤有望重拾氣勢，年底前挑戰5萬點的看法不變。

記憶體看南亞科 載板挑景碩

認定台股仍有好戲，在大盤進入「災後重建」階段，兩人也已各自擬妥布局清單，「第三季，就是汰弱換強的好機會。」張捷強調，現階段，他首先是從ASIC與谷歌TPU概念股當中尋找機會，包括聯發科 （2454）、創意 （3443）等領頭羊，而鴻勁 （7769）、雍智科技（6683）為其後端測試供應商，料將同步受惠；近來鴻勁股價已相對抗跌，雍智在深度修正後也浮現搶短機會。

不過，半導體設備供應鏈家登（3680）以及記憶體廠南亞科（2408），更是他的布局首選。其中，南亞科七月營收優於市場預期，年增逾七倍，第三季營收可望季增約60％，高於先前預估的季增25％到30％，且南亞科在DDR4議價能力強，並有機會列入MSCI成分股，後市看好。張捷認為，雖然近期股價震盪，但屬短線清洗浮額的籌碼調整所致，公司基本面依舊強勁，凱基投顧現階段給予該股的目標價為720元。

至於家登，張捷主要看好其晶圓傳送盒與EUV光罩盒客戶涵蓋四大領域：台積電先進製程、英特爾重啟擴產專案、聯電等成熟製程大廠，最後則是中國的半導體在地化需求。就財務數字看，毛利率近5成，今、明兩年EPS預估為17元與23元，已有法人報告目標價上看5百元以上，值得留意。

此外，載板產業進入超級循環，隨著GPU與CPU升級、HBM堆疊普及，載板需求在面積與用量上暴增，但受限於T-Glass等關鍵材料與製程難度，供給擴張緩慢，形成結構性供需缺口。在此領域中，ABF的欣興（3037）、景碩（3189）、南電（8046）、臻鼎-KY（4958）都已被張捷列為口袋名單，其中景碩更是他在ABF產業中的首選。

至於新藥股仁新（6696），張捷表示，其黃斑部病變用藥已完成三期臨床試驗，市場需求龐大且尚無有效藥物，股價長線有千元的實力，尤其轉投資的Belite公司於那斯達克掛牌且表現優異，法人推估，若依仁新持有 Belite的股權價值回推，Belite 市值約60億美元，仁新持股48.4％，市值871.2億新台幣，除以仁新8.29億元的股本，合理股價為1050元，值得逢低布局。

郭勝同樣聚焦AI題材，其中，他已鎖定逢低買進宏致（3605）、先進光（3362）、凌嘉科（3644）、匯鑽科（8431）以及緯創（3231）。

先進光、大立光 矽光子互補

其中，宏致受惠於高速連接線產品出貨暢旺，帶動伺服器相關營收比重維持高檔，且在ASIC及GPU各平台產品滲透率擴增，AWS和輝達GB系列的高速連接器單價均較傳統高出近20％，機櫃內的高速傳輸線單價也較傳統產品大幅提升。整體而言，宏致的AI產品營收占比今年預估約20％，明年估計可達

news.Title: 大盤「彎弓射箭」瞄準4萬6！多空對決3劇本曝光　專家警告：黑天鵝來了恐殺到這裡
news.Content:
台股昨（11日）站上45,000點大關，今日開盤續彈，資深分析師李永年指出，昨日三大法人同步買超，顯示力道強勁，市場風向已從「資金行情」轉入「景氣行情」，面對這種「利多即漲」的現象，選股應該回歸基本面。觀察盤面結構，原本強勢的矽光子、記憶體族群，與被動元件、PCB良性輪動支撐大盤。不過，李永年提醒，未來大盤有3劇本，除了V型反轉、頭肩底型態之外，也要提防黑天鵝重大利空，一旦大盤回測40,000點，指數可能下探34,000點。

三大法人齊加碼 多頭信心回穩

李永年表示，近期美股多空因素交織，導致走勢震盪，加上伊朗局勢及荷姆茲海峽混沌未明，美國戰備儲油降至1983年以來的新低，油價走高帶動美債殖利率與美金攀升，都對全球股市形成短期壓抑。

不過，台股持續漲勢，昨日站上45,000大關，三大法人也集體站在買方，外資買超達223億元，顯示多頭信心初步回溫，今日不畏美股跌多漲少的衝擊，繼續開出高盤，盤中一度大漲300多點。

健鼎、台達電公布營收 利多即漲

李永年指出，市場的投資邏輯已發生根本性轉變，由「資金行情」進入「景氣行情」，從個股表現就可以得知，例如電源管理龍頭台達電(2308)、PCB大廠健鼎(3044)公布營收後，股價隨即強勢漲停，這種「利多即漲」就是反映多頭思維，此時選股邏輯應回歸基本面，鎖定財報亮眼的標的。

至於盤面結構方面，原本強勢的矽光子、記憶體族群，近期因獲利了結出現回檔，資金轉進被動元件、PCB及大型權值股，良性的輪動支撐大盤穩步攻堅。

未來走勢3劇本 指數點位曝光

李永年指出，大盤未來有3種可能走勢，如果短線再拉出長紅，將形成「彎弓射箭」，直接挑戰46,000至46,500點，甚至續創新高；但如果量能持續不到1兆元，走頭肩底型態，指數會在42,000點至43,000點整理，構築右肩再往上突破套牢區。

最壞的劇本是不慎出現「黑天鵝打擊」，一旦重大利空導致回測40,000點，恐引發信心崩潰，指數可能進一步下探至34,000點附近。

量增才能走得遠 突破需台積電回神

展望後市，李永年認為，短線仍有高點可期，但「量增方能致遠」，要有效突破46,000點以上的巨大套牢量，成交量要緩步增至1.1兆至1.2兆元左右。目前還要觀察的是，當沖已顯著減少，但站穩45,000點大關後，大咖資金是否進場才是關鍵中的關鍵。

另一方面，本土投顧分析，大盤成交量持續低於兆元，盤面漲停題材的強勢股也愈來愈少，甚至不少個股財報不如預期出現重挫，顯示大盤持續在小區間震盪，觀望美國本周將公布的通膨數據。投顧提到，目前趨勢向上還沒有遭到破壞，但要突破成功，需要權王台積電(2330)真回神，投資人要逢高調節走空股，對於題材強勢股，採取紀律操作。

news.Title: 《日股早盤》AI買盤支撐 日經指數上漲0.1%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-12 10:40:12 黃文章 發佈

日經指數週三早盤小漲，日經225指數12日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)上漲0.10%或69.96點，暫收67,040.18。東證股價指數(TOPIX)早盤收盤上漲0.34%或13.80點，暫收4,114.41。

就類股表現來看，截至早盤收盤為止，礦業（2.84%）、銀行業（1.99%）漲幅較大，跌幅較大的類股為醫藥品（-1.35%）、纖維製品（-1.19%）。

受到前一日美國股市部分半導體相關股票上漲的帶動，東京市場中，愛德萬測試（Advantest）與鎧俠（Kioxia）等人工智慧（AI）及半導體相關主要股票也受到買盤追捧。另一方面，由於中東局勢不明朗推升原油價格，加上市場對通膨的憂慮，投資人積極追價買進的氣氛仍然不足。

週三將公布受關注的7月美國消費者物價指數（CPI）。日本國內證券公司的策略師表示：「在目前仍看不清荷姆茲海峽何時解除封鎖的情況下，如果CPI高於市場預期，市場可能擔心這將促使美國聯準會提前升息，因此目前有許多投資人採取觀望態度。」

news.Title: 美股觀望CPI　台股權值股發威　開盤續漲逾300點拚站穩45K
news.Content:
【緯來新聞網】美伊和平協議進展有限，加上市場靜待美國通膨數據，美股昨夜震盪偏弱，僅費半指數受惠記憶體股走強逆勢上漲0.87％；台股ADR則全面收高，台積電（2330）ADR上漲0.86％，帶動台指期夜盤上漲194點、收45,279點。台股12日開高，隨後在台積電開高至2,405元，攜手鴻海（2317）、華邦電（2344）、南亞科（2408）及廣達（2382）等電子要角走強助攻下，漲點一度擴大至近380點，指數直逼45,500點大關。

台股12日開高，隨後在台積電開高至2,405元（圖／證交所）

台積電最新動作備受矚目，董事會通過2026年第2季每股現金股利7元，並核准逾9500億元資本預算，聚焦先進製程及封裝產能擴充。此外，台積電與索尼半導體解決方案公司簽署最終合作協議，將在日本熊本合資設立Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation，計畫2029年量產智慧手機影像感測器。索尼與台積電分別投資約4650億及2820億日圓。

國內其他重量級企業也展現強勁成長動能。鴻海旗下工業富聯上半年營收達人民幣5578.6億元，年增54.6％，淨利更飆升96％創同期新高。PCB廠臻鼎-KY持續擴大伺服器及光模組業務，業績倍增，並鎖定2027年成為全球最大高階光模組供應商目標。封測廠矽品精密啟動耗資千億元的斗六新廠建設，計劃導入CoWoS先進封裝技術。仁寶則積極擴展AI伺服器產能，美國德州及越南新廠陸續投產，力拼AI市場布局。

美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）將於台灣時間週三晚間揭曉，市場關注這份數據將如何影響聯準會（Fed）9月利率決策。市場預期7月CPI年增率約3.4％、月增0.1％，核心CPI年增2.5％、月增0.2％。芝加哥商品交易所FedWatch工具顯示，Fed下月升息機率約50％，反映市場對下一步政策走向尚無共識。雖然Fed偏重核心個人消費支出物價指數（Core PCE），但CPI因較早公布，仍影響短期市場預期。

法人指出，台股短線雖維持震盪反彈格局，但量能未能同步有效放大，多頭若要再戰前高，仍需成交量補足、買盤進一步回籠。隨著營收與季報公布進入尾聲，市場短期缺乏明確基本面利多接棒，指數波動料將加劇。展望後市，季線將成為多方重要防線，若能守穩，有利維持震盪偏多格局。

news.Title: 美股光通訊巨頭報喜！光聖華星光亮燈 分析師曝操作關鍵
news.Content:
美股光通訊巨頭 Lumentum（LITE.US）昨日繳出優於預期的財報表現，因此大漲 7%，今日台股光通訊概念股也開出紅花，華星光（4979）率先亮燈，族群股王聯亞（3081）、上詮（3163）等個股也同步漲逾半根。分析師認為光通訊雖然看起來本益比偏高，但目前來說仍可以沿著五日線介入短線操作，但應做好若跌破短期均線就要出場的準備。

Lumentum 11日美股盤後公布會計年度第四季度財報：營收年增109.3%；經調整的每股盈餘為3.23美元，遠高於去年同期的0.88美元，整體財報表現優於預期，不僅盤中已有7%漲幅，盤後更續漲2%，表現亮眼。

在美股巨頭領漲下，台股包含光聖、華星光漲停，波若威、聯亞、光環、穩懋等個股全數拉出半根以上的漲幅，族群開出一片紅花。

啟發投顧分析師白易弘就指出，Lumentum的財報表現佳對光通訊族群是利多，雖然整體本益比偏高，不過近期一路都是沿著5日均線上漲，可以待股價回測5日均線，適度追價以短線方式操作，若跌破短期均線則迅速停利離場。

許如鎧／財經特派記者，主跑經濟部、電子電信、能源等

news.Title: 記憶體掌兵符！力積電重返70元大關躍居成交量王 南亞科衝上511元創新高
news.Content:
記憶體族群今（12）日再度強勢發動，力積電（6770）開盤後買盤大舉湧入，早盤一度急拉8%，股價重返70元大關，開盤半小時，成交量快速突破13萬張，躍居台股成交量王。南亞科（2408）一度衝上511元，刷新歷史新高。華邦電（2344）、群聯（8299）等記憶體股也同步走揚。

截至上午9時30分，族群指標股南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）雙雙漲逾2%，分別報在499.5元、184.5元；南亞科早盤一度衝上511元，不但重返500元大關，更創下歷史新高價。另外，力積電一度急拉8%至73元，成交量高達13.6萬張，高局台股成交量之冠。

另外，群聯（8299）漲5%，報2,200元。旺宏（2337）、晶豪科（3006）也漲約3%。模組廠部分，宜鼎（5289）以及宇瞻（8271）同樣表現強勢，漲幅逾4%。

回顧近期記憶體走勢，先前市場受到花旗證券分析師看空記憶體價格的報告壓抑，花旗證券分析師Atif Malik報告指出，雖維持美光科技「買進」評等，卻將目標價從 1400 美元大砍至 1150 美元。報告說明，經與記憶體供應鏈上下游業者交叉查證後研判，DRAM 與 NAND 價格漲勢將在未來四季逐步收斂，並可能於明年 5 月見頂。

花旗進一步認為，這波記憶體價格漲勢降溫，主要與中國記憶體廠長鑫科技與長江存儲持續擴產有關，供給增加可能對市場價格行程壓力。

不過，摩根大通策略師 Jay Kwon本周釋出相對樂觀看法，他指出，在價格與出貨量同步推升下，記憶體潛在市場規模（TAM）將持續擴大，供需短缺未來兩年仍將延續。此外，記憶體需求正從 GPU 擴散至 CPU，但這項趨勢可能仍遭投資人低估，意味著未來記憶體需求預估仍存在進一步上修空間。

王詩婷／財經特派記者，主跑勞動部、半導體、生技等

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股續揚漲逾370點 分析師萬相和：追價意願有限
news.Content:
美股四大指數跌多漲少，台股今（12）日加權指數開盤上漲54.98點、以45175.7點開出，隨後在電子、金融及傳產股齊力助攻下，漲幅迅速擴大至逾370點，指數一度攻上45,498.05點，穩守4萬5千點大關。啟發投顧分析師萬相和表示，由於市場正等待美國今晚公布7月消費者物價指數（CPI）數據，追價買盤意願有限，預期今日大盤漲點落在300點至500點。

今日值班分析師：啟發投顧分析師萬相和

萬相和表示，儘管美股主要指數收黑，但AI雲端服務商CoreWeave第二季營收翻倍，帶動AI產業氣氛回溫，加上台積電股價維持穩健，成為支撐台股今日走高的主要力量。

萬相和指出，台積電近期大致在2350元至2400元區間整理，即使前幾日台股回檔，股價跌幅仍相對有限，說明下檔具有支撐。不過，市場正等待美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）公布，觀望氣氛仍濃，加上台股上方較大壓力落在45,900點附近，台積電、鴻海等大型權值股今日僅小幅上漲，預期今日指數漲點可能落在300點至500點之間，若無重大消息干擾，尾盤翻黑機率不高。

盤面焦點集中在記憶體族群，受美股相關個股逆勢走強激勵，南亞科早盤突破500元、再創歷史新高，華邦電大漲逾5%，旺宏也上揚超過3%；矽晶圓、低軌衛星、矽智財及AI概念股同步獲得資金青睞。

另外，萬相和指出，櫃買指數盤中逼近400點，表現優於集中市場，若能成功站上整數關卡，中小型題材股有機會接棒大型權值股，成為盤面多方主力。

至於AI伺服器組裝廠近期陸續召開法說會，萬相和認為，鴻海近期經過整理後逐步墊高，走勢相對強勢；緯創先前已創新高，仍是大型代工廠中表現較突出的個股，廣達上方則面臨較多壓力。隨著相關業者將陸續召開法說會，AI伺服器展望仍可關注，但不宜提前追高押寶。受CPI公布前觀望氣氛影響，預估今日成交量約落在8000億元至9000億元。

news.Title: 台股「風電國家隊」爆下市危機！獨董跑光又欠一屁股債
news.Content:
上市公司暴雷，風電鑄件大廠永冠-KY財報難產，三席獨立董事全數辭任，且未能在期限內完成補選，證交所昨（11日）公告，永冠-KY自13日起併案列為變更交易辦法，全額交割維持停止買賣狀態，目前4.3萬名股東欲哭無淚。

股東欲哭無淚 爆下市危機

永冠-KY財務狀況持續惡化，且公司治理爆發重大危機，無法繳交2025年及2026年第一季財務報告，同時無法如期償還境內第四次無擔保轉換公司債，也未能在期限內償還債務或與債權人完成協商。

早在4月7日起，其上市股票與無擔保轉換公司債就已遭到停止買賣。如今，狀況持續惡化，永冠-KY的三席獨立董事均已辭任，且未能於規定內完成補選，如果狀況遲遲無法改善，最快可能在11月18日下市。

曾是風電國家隊成員 重大營運危機

永冠-KY在4月1日是暫停交易前的最後交易日，當天股價收在5.54元。截至上周，永冠-KY總股東人數為43,147人，持有超過千張的大股東佔比達21%，其次是持有1至5張的小股東，比例為次高的14.37%，每位股東平均持有3.55張。

永冠-KY過去是全球金屬鑄件製造大廠，專注在再生能源、產業機械及工具機等領域，過去曾被視為風電國家隊成員，具備一條龍式大型客製化鑄造能力，股價一度衝上百元。

然而，近年出現嚴重經營問題，年初也傳出無法償還銀行借款，短期借款總規模超過10億元，將於今年內陸續到期，短期不見任何好轉跡象，下市危機拉警報。

news.Title: 台積電配息7元！ 開放外資「領美元股息」將與Sony合資新公司
news.Content:
晶圓代工龍頭台積電11日召開董事會，拍板2026年第2季財務報表及多項重大決議。台積電第2季合併營收達新台幣1兆2703.8億元，稅後純益7065.6億元，每股純益（EPS）27.25元，董事會並核准每股配發7元現金股利，預計2027年1月7日發放。

台積電表示，本次除息交易日訂於2026年12月10日，配息基準日為12月16日，配合金管會法規修訂，外資股東自本次股利分派起，可選擇以美元收取現金股利，美國存託憑證（ADR）除息日及配息基準日同樣為12月10日。

資本支出方面，董事會核准約294億4250萬美元資本預算，主要用於先進製程、先進封裝、成熟及特殊製程產能，以及廠房與廠務設施建置，持續因應AI、高效能運算等長期需求。

此外，台積電也拍板與索尼半導體解決方案公司（Sony Semiconductor Solutions）合資成立新公司，雙方將在日本熊本布局下一世代影像感測器的研發與製造。依規劃，Sony預計投入約4650億日圓，台積電則投資約2820億日圓，合資公司預計2029年開始量產，瞄準智慧型手機等市場。

在先進封裝方面，台積電表示，今年已成功量產5.5倍光罩尺寸的CoWoS封裝，良率穩定維持98%以上，預計2029年進一步推進至14倍光罩尺寸以上，持續強化AI晶片封裝能力。

（封面圖／台積電提供）

news.Title: 「瑤池金母」為何狠心砍光南亞科？專家曝背後隱情：大家都猜錯了
news.Content:
記憶體大廠南亞科昨（11日）下跌2.5%，收在489元，引發市場疑慮是否與被股民封為「瑤池金母」的明星經理人陳釧瑤操盤主動統一台股增長「00981A」清空持股有關。對此專家表示，00981A出清南亞科是因經理人高檔獲利了結以維持績效，加上連動度高的美光遭外資下修目標價，並非南亞科基本面轉壞，投資人無須過度擔憂。

00981A於7月22日才進場買進南亞科，當時股價約落在430至440元區間；才持股半個多月時間，在8月10日趁股價強勢攻上漲停之際，一口氣拋售939張持股，套現約4.71億元，僅保留1張。

從最新持股變化來看，00981A在南亞科獲利落袋後迅速調整資產配置，將資金轉進其他標的，包含加碼日月光約 13.2 億元、台達電約6.6億元，並進場布局欣銓與富世達，合計買超金額達21.4億元。

永誠國際投顧分析師李蜀芳指出，00981A出清南亞科並非看壞基本面，而是經理人為維持基金績效或應對贖回，選擇在股價逼近前波高點時獲利了結。此外，花旗銀行近期調降美光目標價，由於南亞科與美光在台股具備高度連動與指標意義，因而同步面臨短線壓抑。

花旗最新發布報告指出，預估DRAM與NAND快閃記憶體價格，未來四個季度將逐季趨緩，並於2027年第2季攀頂後，於同年下半年可能面臨季減3%與5%的幅度。考量記憶體報價成長動能漸失，花旗將美光目標價自1400美元調降至1150美元，但仍給予「買進」評等。

news.Title: 台股狂衝證交稅亮眼　前7月年增1.9倍刷新高
news.Content:
股市起伏牽動國家稅收。財政部今(11)日發布稅收統計，7月全國賦稅收入2,891億元，年降67％，主因去(2025)年所得稅結算申報及繳納期限延長，稅款遞延至7月，以致基期偏高；累計1至7月稅收2兆8,767億元，年增25％。7月台股巨幅回檔，成交量萎縮，但證交稅收651億元，仍較去年同期大增1.7倍；總計前7月證交稅收3,987億元，創史上同期新高。

7月實徵淨額與去年同月比較，以營所稅減少3,464億元、綜所稅縮減3,123億元最多，證交稅則增加412億之多。累計前7月稅收以證交稅飆升2,593億元、營所稅上揚1,533億元、營業稅成長838億元最多，稅收達成率72.9％。

7月增幅最大的莫過於證交稅收，7月上市櫃股票平均每日成交值為1兆1,532億元，前7月每日成交值為1兆1,706億元，分別較去年同期暴增1.8倍及1.9倍。7月單月證交稅收651億元，年飆1.7倍，連續12個月正成長，但與6月相比下滑23.3％。累計1至7月證交稅收3,987億元，年增2,593億元，雙雙刷新高，增幅1.9倍，則是1998年以來同期最高。

營所稅7月實徵86億元，年墜97.6％，主因去年為了因應美國對等關稅衝擊，所得稅申報及繳納期限延長，稅款延至7月入帳，基期較高所致。統計前7月營所稅實徵淨額為7,889億，年升1,533億元，升幅24.1％。綜所稅實徵191億元，年降94.2％，同樣因為去年結算申報延期至7月，基期較高。累計1至7月綜所稅實徵淨額為6,899億元，年增695億元，成長11.2％。

營業稅7月實徵淨額為1,376億元，年增251億元，增加22.3％，累計1至7月實徵4,872億元，年揚838億，上升20.8％，因內需增加，資通與視聽產品、電子零組件等進口代徵稅額提高；但出口暢旺，適用外銷零稅率申請退稅也升高，抵銷部分增幅。

7月貨物稅實徵116億元，小升4％，主要是進口車稅額增加、汽柴油貨物稅減幅擴大，油氣類稅額減少互抵所致。累計1至7月，貨物稅實徵淨額694億元，衰退18.1％，與汽柴油降稅、新購汽機車及電動車減免徵退稅有關。

財政部指出，1至7月營所稅、綜所稅、營業稅、證交稅、期交稅、關稅、房屋稅、遺產稅、娛樂稅、印花稅均攀上歷年同期高點。至於前7月稅收已超過今(2026)年全年預算目標的稅目，包含有證交稅、期交稅及房屋稅。

news.Title: 台股大盤緩跌是台積電假象？阮慕驊揭「個股腰斬死一片」：這才是真正的破滅
news.Content:
台股近幾周經歷重大的慘烈回檔，近日雖終於回彈，但仍有不少受重傷的投資人未能恢復元氣。（資料照，中央社）

台股近幾周經歷重大的慘烈回檔，雖近日終於開始強勢反攻，看似最底部已經過去，但仍有不少受重傷的投資人未能恢復元氣，也對空頭可能尚未結束抱持警戒。對此，財經專家 阮慕驊 分析，這波股災其實台美股有個「高度共通點」，也證明許多投資人受的傷，遠比大盤重挫幅度還要更深。

阮慕驊在節目《聽，阮大哥的！》指出，這一波的底部應是暫時確立了，但問題是高點還能不能繼續突破？他對此進行研究，從美股費半指數與台股上市櫃來分析，這一波修正的結構到底是什麼、低點是否還可信，以及未來可能的回檔空間。

​美股重挫情況如何？費半1個月殺掉28%​​​

阮慕驊提到，美股方面，費城半導體指數僅1個月的時間就殺掉28.7%，下殺幅度相當大，從6月22日的高點14655、跌到7月29日的低點10445，「可以看到跟台股櫃買、加權指數幾乎是同步的。」

阮慕驊指出，台股上市櫃指數也分別在7月29日跟30日落底，單點集中非常明顯，代表台美股那時是爆發典型「全面性恐慌賣壓」，且不同股票的情況可說是兩個世界，跌最深的中小型股票股價直接腰斬，但輝達等權值股相對抗跌。

​台股大盤跌的其實不重？阮慕驊揭護國神山撐住​

阮慕驊表示，而台股加權指數本波段的跌幅是18.3%，但其實多數股票都跌得更深，他統計前100大上市櫃權值股，「有74檔跌幅都超過指數」，但占大盤42%權重的台積電股價僅跌14%，可說是由台積電撐住，是指數跌幅遠遠小於個股的主要原因。

阮慕驊分析，對照台美股市這波修正的共通點，就是都由權值股在抗跌護盤，費半就是輝達跟台積電ADR、台股就是台積電，但重災區股價就是幾乎腰斬，跌幅大於指數非常明顯，「結論是指數溫和，但個股波動非常劇烈，只看指數並不能描述這次下跌的慘烈。」

​中小型股恐更慘烈？阮慕驊曝熱錢回不來原因​

阮慕驊直言，所以台股大盤只跌18%，但為何這麼多人受傷，就是因為很多股票的跌幅都一口氣砍到5成，這才是真正的破滅，「而且我只統計百大權值股，如果把所有股票都統計進來的，情況會更慘烈，中小型股回檔幅度可能更深。」

阮慕驊提到，而股市現在為何量能不出，他觀察是因為很多人受傷太重而直接退出市場，另一群人則是即使反彈回升也不敢進場，最後是仍有非常多人可能至今還被套牢在高點，也沒有再進場的資金，因此形成了資金被卡死的狀況，使得成交量出不來。

news.Title: 7月台股劇烈震盪  證交稅大減23％  降至651億元
news.Content:
財政部今日公布賦稅收入，7月台股大幅震盪，使得證交稅也受到影響，日均交易量雖仍有1兆5232億元，但是月減約25％，使得證交稅單月稅收降至651億元，不過累計證交稅已經達到3987億元，。

財政部公布的數據顯示，今年前7月稅收已經達到2兆8767億元，較去年增加5746億元。

7月台股震盪劇烈，7月17日下跌2954點，創下歷史最大跌點，月底指數收在43119.75點，較6月大跌約3006點，為史上第2大月跌點，僅次於今年3月，跌幅6.5％。台股震盪也導致量縮，7月日均交易量縮至1兆5232億元，月減25％，因此單月證交稅收651億元，雖仍是歷史第3高，不過相較6月，減幅也達到23％。

前7月的證交稅收累計有3987億元，為民國87年以來同期最高，而且已經超越去年全年的證交稅收。

至於房地相關的稅收，受惠於新建案交屋與部分縣市調整房屋標準單價所貢獻，契稅單月、累計都呈現雙增的情況，契稅7月稅收17億元，年增率19.4％，累計前7月97億元，年增7.7％。

但是土增稅7月59億元，年減10.9％；累計前7月392億元，年減8.5％；另外，個人房地合一稅50億元，年減14.1％、累計前7月僅只有275億元，年減6.8％，房市景氣尚未完全回神。

財政部表示，7月創單月新高有營業稅，稅收1376億元，年增22.3％，主要是台灣貿易活絡，海關代徵營業稅所貢獻；另外印花稅7月稅收32億元，也創歷史新高，年增19.7％，主要是銀行放款應稅憑證增加所致。

news.Content:

(2330)台積電-Sony與台積公司同意成立合資公司支援下一世代影像感測器

1.事實發生日:115/08/11

2.公司名稱:台灣積體電路製造股份有限公司

3.與公司關係(請輸入本公司或子公司):本公司

4.相互持股比例:不適用

6.因應措施:不適用

7.其他應敘明事項(若事件發生或決議之主體係屬公開發行以上公司，本則重大訊息同時符合證券交易法施行細則第7條第9款所定對股東權益或證券價格有重大影響之事項):

索尼半導體解決方案公司（Sony）與台積公司今（11）日宣布雙方簽署具法律效力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司Advanced Vision

Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於2029年開始量產。

此合資公司將由Sony作為單一控制股東，並計畫以索尼集團（Sony Group）公司之合併子公司營運。此合資公司之代表董事將由Sony指派。

依據最終協議，Sony計畫透過現金投入及公司分割之資產轉移(註)方式，挹注合資公司共約4,650億日圓；台積公司則計畫投資現金約2,820億日圓。這些資金的投入將基於市場需求及其他相關業務條件分階段進行。除了Sony與台積公司所投入的資金，有關實現此合資公司產能規畫所需要的投資，其考量前提是必須能夠獲得來自日本政府的支持。

在此策略合作夥伴關係下，Sony將在核心影像感測器技術的研發、產品規劃與設計中擔任領導角色，而此合資公司計畫利用台積公司的先進製程技術與製造專業來推動量產所需的生產研發與製造。透過此次合作，雙方將加速推動受客戶需求驅動的影像感測器產品進入市場，同時促進技術創新與強化製造能力。

此合資公司的設立與交易完成條件皆須取得必要的主管機關核准，並遵循交易常規。

有關此策略合作夥伴關係的其他事宜，請依Sony與台積公司於今年5月8日發布之「Sony與台積公司初步達成下一世代影像感測器策略合作協議」新聞稿為準。

註：Sony在日本熊本縣合志市已投資之新建廠房。

台積公司今（11）日召開董事會，會中重要決議如下：

一、核准2026年第二季營業報告書及財務報表，其中第二季合併營收約新台幣1兆2,703億8千萬元，稅後純益約新台幣7,065億6千萬元，每股盈餘為新台幣27.25元。

二、核准配發2026年第二季之每股現金股利7.0元，其普通股配息基準日訂定為2026年12月16日，除息交易日則為2026年12月10日。依公司法第一六五條規定，在公司決定分派股息之基準日前五日內，亦即自2026年12月12日起至12月16日止，停止普通股股票過戶，並於2027年1月7日發放。此外，因應台灣金管會法規修訂，台積公司將自本次股利分派開始提供依「華僑及外國人投資證券管理辦法」投資之外資股東以美元收受現金股利之選擇權利。台積公司在美國紐約證券交易所上市之美國存託憑證之除息交易日及配息基準日皆為2026年12月10日。

三、為了因應基於市場需求預測及技術開發藍圖所制定的長期產能規劃，核准資本預算約美金294億4,250萬元，內容主要包括：1. 建置及升級先進製程產能；2. 建置及升級先進封裝、成熟及/或特殊製程產能；3. 廠房興建及廠務設施工程。

四、核准與索尼半導體解決方案公司（Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation）合資成立新公司，以研發與製造下一世代影像感測器，以及於不超過日幣2,820億元之額度內認購該合資公司之股份。

news.Title: 三大法人連2天同步買超　外資加碼223億元華邦電居冠
news.Content:
（中央社記者何秀玲台北2026年8月11日電）台股今天漲191.96點，收在45120.72點，成交值新台幣8690.16億元。三大法人連2日同步站在買方，今天合計買超281.78億元；外資加碼華邦電 (2344) 、至上 (8112) 、中鋼 (2002) 等個股，其中買超華邦電3萬7872張居冠。

三大法人今天合計買超281.78億元，其中自營商買超24.6億元，投信買超33.9億元，外資及陸資買超223.28億元。

外資買超前5名，華邦電3萬7872張居冠、至上3萬3079張居次，其餘依序為中鋼、第一金 (2892) 、主動統一台股增長（00981A）。

外資賣超前5名，友達 (2409) 5萬6259張居首、華航 (2610) 2萬6706張居次，其餘依序為合庫金 (5880) 、主動復華未來50（00991A）、台企銀 (2834) 。

萬寶投顧執行長王榮旭對中央社記者表示，台股7月拉回修正，一度拉回至39000多點，近期已反彈近6000點並站上45000點，但量能並未明顯放大，因部分投資人認為漲幅已大不敢追價，反而形成軋空走勢；外資昨天大幅回補，今天再買超逾200億元，顯示外資操作心態與先前台股下跌階段已有所轉變。

王榮旭指出，目前國際主要股市表現仍佳，加上企業財報具有獲利支撐，對台股大盤後市不悲觀；台積電 (2330) 7月營收再創歷史新高，也為大盤提供基本面支撐，現階段行情重點反而漸轉向個股表現。

他表示，由於市場量能不足以支撐所有股票上漲，預期個股將呈現分化及族群輪動格局。隨著半年報、7月營收陸續公布，法人與市場大戶將從財報數字尋找下半年業績成長股，8月中下旬至9月行情重點可能不在大盤，而在個股表現。

力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司Advanced Vision

Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，

作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於2029年

開始量產。

此合資公司將由Sony作為單一控制股東，並計畫以索尼集團（Sony Group）公

司之合併子公司營運。此合資公司之代表董事將由Sony指派。

資公司共約4,650億日圓；台積公司則計畫投資現金約2,820億日圓。這些資金的

投入將基於市場需求及其他相關業務條件分階段進行。除了Sony與台積公司所投

入的資金，有關實現此合資公司產能規畫所需要的投資，其考量前提是必須能夠

獲得來自日本政府的支持。

在此策略合作夥伴關係下，Sony將在核心影像感測器技術的研發、產品規劃與

設計中擔任領導角色，而此合資公司計畫利用台積公司的先進製程技術與製造專

業來推動量產所需的生產研發與製造。透過此次合作，雙方將加速推動受客戶需

求驅動的影像感測器產品進入市場，同時促進技術創新與強化製造能力。

此合資公司的設立與交易完成條件皆須取得必要的主管機關核准，並遵循交易

有關此策略合作夥伴關係的其他事宜，請依Sony與台積公司於今年5月8日發布

之「Sony與台積公司初步達成下一世代影像感測器策略合作協議」新聞稿為準。

• Distributable cash flow (DCF) was CA$2.9 billion in Q2, up 35.2% year-over-year, supporting its dividend which has increased for 31 consecutive years.
• Enbridge has sanctioned up to CA$20 billion in projects, including those for hyperscalers and data centers, with a secured capital backlog of CA$41 billion.
• The company is diversifying into renewable energy and has expanded its natural gas utility platform, serving over 7 million customers.

news.Title: 財女Jenny揭投資美股「大、穩、賺錢」三大心法 善用009820掌握AI成長紅利
news.Content: 《鉅亨網》今 (11) 日舉辦「布局核心投資機會 掌握美股科技成長浪潮」論壇，邀請納斯達克首席經濟學家 Phil Mackintosh 與「JC 財經觀點」創辦人財女 Jenny 剖析全球經濟與美股投資趨勢。財女 Jenny 從實戰投資角度分析，指出當前美股已進入「大者恆大、強者恆強」的時代，投資人應透過「大、穩、賺錢」三大指標，精準捕捉 AI 科技革命帶來的財富重組契機。投資人可善用定期定額與 5 至 10 年的長期布局策略，藉由元大納斯達克精選 (009820-TW) 等美股 ETF，穩健卡位 AI 科技的未來成長紅利。 Jenny 一開場就詢問觀眾是否僅把 AI 工具當成「高級 Google」詢問簡單生活資訊，她直言，AI 真正威力在於將重複性、複雜的工作流程自動化及系統化。從輝達黃仁勳提出的「五層蛋糕理論」到台積電的「三層蛋糕理論」，管理層已明確畫出未來的獲利藍圖。 Jenny 指出，台美股市在 AI 供應鏈上高度緊密相連，投資人可透過科技巨頭財報、供應鏈訂單與台灣海關出口數據，精準掌握 AI 產業輪動。針對當前市場環境，她提出「不只買大，更要買強」的美股投資顯學。 Jenny 分析，自 2011 年以來，美股獲利高度集中於少數科技巨頭。在 AI 時代，基礎設施動輒需要數千億美元的資本投入，中小企業根本無力參戰，使得大型科技股具備無可替代的壟斷與規模優勢。相較於高波動的小型股，美股大型科技股兼具高年化報酬與較低波動度，更適合長期持有。 Jenny 歸納出選股的 「大、穩、賺錢」 三大關鍵指標，首先要看規模與地位，觀察市值規模、營收規模與指數權重。規模大代表市場認同度高、產業護城河深，短期內絕難被競爭對手取代。 其次要穩，投資人可關注「營收是否高速成長」、「毛利率」與「營業利潤率」。營收成長代表公司身處高擴張市場；高毛利與營業利潤則展現公司的產品定價權與經營效率，確保獲利品質無虞。 最後是要賺錢，投資股票看的是「未來的獲利潛力」而非僅是過去的紀錄。企業是否具備「第二成長曲線」，是決定長期估值能否持續墊高的關鍵，例如蘋果結合 AI 的潛在換機潮與訂閱生態。 Jenny 強調，隨著科技不斷突破、全球經濟在 AI 浪潮下持續成長，投資人應把握每一次技術創新所帶來的「財富重分配」歷史機遇，透過佈局具備強大護城河與獲利變現能力的美股科技巨頭，穩健掌握核心資產的長期成長紅利。 專家傳授美股科技戰略 善用 009820 掌握 AI 成長紅利 元大投信研究團隊指出，美國第二季企業獲利成長率估達 47%，且預期獲利呈現難得的上修，反映企業具備優異且持續的賺錢能力；同時 CPI 與核心 PCE 年增率持續放緩，失業率與 GDP 數據穩健，市場對聯準會繼續升息的預期已大幅冷卻。歷史數據顯示，升息循環若有強勁獲利或科技趨勢支撐，股市依然能維持亮眼漲幅。 針對投資人關心的下半年美股兩大影響因子，元大投信表示，選前 3 個月波動雖大，但選後不確定性消除將迎來反彈，且歷史上總統任期第 3 年多為大牛市。更重要的是 AI 科技創新，目前大型科技股具備強勁現金流與實質盈餘 (本益比約 21.5 倍，非 2000 年網路泡沫)，未來基建資本支出仍有擴充空間，將持續帶動半導體與軟硬體需求。 面對市場波動，元大投信建議採取定期定額與長期持有 5-10 年，為最佳投資策略，利用時間複利平攤成本並提高正報酬確定性。009820 追蹤「Nasdaq 100 增強指數」，透過研發費用率、營運穩定度、營收與 EPS 成長率四大指標，精選出 30 檔核心龍頭，兼具低費用率、軟硬體均衡配置與強勁的反彈爆發力，是參與未來十年 AI 成長脈動的優質工具。

news.Title: 兆豐投信2台股ETF大啖AI供應鏈商機
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】美國雲端服務供應商（CSP）最新2026年第2季財報與法說會釋出重磅利多！因AI需求強勁與零組件成本攀升，多數科技巨頭上修資本支出展望。根據市場預估，美國5大CSP業者2026年整體資本支出將大幅上修至7951億美元（年增率達77%），2027 年更將進一步突破1.06兆美元（年增率33%）。這波龐大的結構性上升週期，將直接為台灣AI半導體及藍籌大廠注入長期的營運成長動能。

兆豐投信旗下2大台股指標ETF—兆豐台灣晶圓製造（00913）與兆豐藍籌30（00690），恰逢8月除息旺季，2檔ETF的除息交易日皆訂於8月18日，投資人只要在8月17日前買進或持有，即可參與本次除息。各大CSP管理層看法高度一致，重申AI運算、雲端基礎設施與電源零組件產能為當前最關鍵的瓶頸，印證AI基礎建設投資週期仍處於早期階段，未來數年將維持結構性上升趨勢，為台灣相關供應鏈提供強勁的成長動能。

在此產業趨勢下，專注鎖定台灣半導體的兆豐台灣晶圓製造 ETF展現驚人的「黑馬之姿」。由於CSP積極擴建資料中心，對於先進晶圓代工、高頻寬記憶體（HBM）及網通設備的需求呈現強勁增長，其核心持股精準布局晶圓代工龍頭與半導體關鍵供應鏈，成功吸引市場關注，帶動基金受益人數持續刷新成立後新高。除此之外，今年以來受益人數增幅達到315%，位居台股半導體 ETF成長之冠，成為投資人參與AI半導體長線行情的核心配置首選。

採季配息機制的兆豐藍籌30 ETF，則全面配置財務結構健全、具備產業代表性且獲利能力高的大型藍籌股。隨著AI商機落地，台股供應鏈中的AI電源基礎設施、伺服器、液冷散熱及光通訊等權值大廠營運持續獲得上修。兼顧抗震韌性與隨大盤進攻的特性，成為投資人在高波動市場中，攻守兼備的台股市值型布局選項。（自立電子報2026/8/11）

news.Title: 台股開低走高站上4萬5大關　台積電收漲15元
news.Content:
【記者許麗珍／台北報導】荷莫茲海峽重新開放的談判再陷僵局，美股10日收跌。台股今開低走高但盤中上下震盪，終場上漲191.96點或0.43%，收在45,120.72點，站上4萬5大關，成交金額8690.16億元。權值股台積電今早先開平盤，隨後小漲5元，終場上漲15元收2395元。

荷莫茲海峽重新開放的談判再陷僵局，美股受賣壓籠罩，4大指數今（10）日全面走低，費半重挫近3%，台積電ADR收黑。

道瓊工業指數小挫60.95點或0.11%，收53975.98點，標準普爾500指數微跌4.53點或0.06%，收7753.11點；那斯達克指數下滑85.26點或0.32%，收26605.36點，費城半導體指數重挫362.93點或2.94%，收11993.86點。

市場對聯準會升息預期降低，資金重回高估值的科技股，台股10日盤中大漲近千點，終場上漲702.85點，收在44928.76點。根據台灣證券交易所統計，三大法人合計買超新台幣731.67億元。

此外，台積電公布7月營收新台幣4675.8億元，再創歷史新高，較6月增加5.6%，較去年同期增加44.7%。法人指出，2奈米等先進製程需求強勁，是推升7月營收創高的主要動力。

news.Title: 台股法說行情開跑 高含積ETF吹反攻號角
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】AI基建泡沫疑慮淡化，市場信心逐步回溫，台股也從39384.85低點急彈、盤勢守穩在季線之上，法人表示，台股受惠台積電7月營收發燙，創連3個月創單月歷史新高，成台股定心丸；各家法說會行情持續上演，預估企業獲利、營運前景有助提振市場信心，預估未來大盤站穩季線後，有利於波段行情發展，建議投資人現階段可鎖定高含積量台股ETF、半導體ETF分批布局，未來股價有機會隨8/26輝達財報題材發酵，中長線則看好2027年科技股作夢題材加持，帶旺ETF股價吹反攻號角，重啟新一波攻勢。

台新臺灣半導體30 ETF（00904）經理人張意聆表示，今年美股企業盈利強勁，且有跡象表明大型雲端科技業者(Hyperscaler)的AI投資，將推動營收實現更快增長，帶動美股上周主要指數回血，費半及那指紛紛大漲。台積電最新公布7月營收再創新高，也顯示晶圓代工龍頭受惠於先進製程與先進封裝供不應求，尤其是2奈米量產、加上3奈米產出增加，帶動台積電7月營收再創單月歷史新高，也二度上修全年美元營收展望。表示企業財報利多，正帶動市場風險偏好回升，有助於現階段台股行情雖仍震盪，中長線並不看淡。

news.Title: 台股ETF 10猛將 近1年績效翻倍
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】美伊戰爭再現曙光，加上道瓊與標普500指數創新高，費城半導體指數大漲等利多帶動，激勵加權指數強攻重返4萬4000點關卡之上，在AI股強攻下，加權指數近一年大漲逾87%，而台股ETF 10猛將近1年更是績效翻倍，漲贏大盤40%以上，其中，國內唯一同時聚焦IC設計與記憶體的的台股ETF台新臺灣IC設計（00947）受惠多檔成份股漲停的帶動，近1年唯一大漲逾170%，高居台股主被動ETF第1，較大盤超額報酬高達85%，實力驚人。

近1年漲幅第1的台新臺灣IC設計成份股為兩大熱門族群高價IP/IC類股及記憶體類股合計占比超過8成，10大成份股包括：聯發科、華邦電、南亞科、群聯、創意、台達電、世芯、信驊、旺宏、矽力，皆是今年來飆漲的熱門股，因此推升00947股價頻創新高。

台新臺灣IC設計研究團隊指出，AI發展日新月異並光速推進，算力需求跟著大噴發，高盛預估2030年全球每月token處理量將達120千兆個，是2026年現有算力水平的24倍。台股AI股競爭地位在全球首屈一指，受惠程度大，分析師預估台股AI股2026獲利成長率上看5成以上，IC設計及記憶體成長動能相對看好，建議布局聚焦「IC設計+記憶體」雙組合的台股ETF，對於買不起高價股的小資族而言，布局00947可參與高價股大漲的榮景。

今年來大漲144%的台新臺灣半導體30 ETF（00904）經理人張意聆表示，7月半導體股大跌後急彈，反映AI進入獲利驗證期，引發資金流出高資本支出的科技股，半導體股價也陷入修正，不過，觀察美科技巨頭最新公布的財報，像CSP雲端龍頭企業，仍維持新增AI資本支出計劃；同時，CSP財報內容中，AI投資也有反映公司獲利成長跡象，顯示科技大廠新增AI投資，有助於持續創造高於資金成本的價值。

張意聆強調，目前科技大廠的AI建置處於技術投資初期，2026年算是爬坡期，對於預估未來AI收入及生產效益將於2027年滯後顯現，預估半導體股價短期內，仍將受高利率、AI商業化驗證壓抑評價，但進入8月起至今年底，只要美國利率緊縮預期降溫，資金壓力緩解，半導體股估值有望快速修復，7月股價下殺應屬正常牛市整理，整體科技股估值修復時點，可能落在今年第4季。（自立電子報2026/8/11）

news.Title: 國巨飆回6字頭能追？專家急喊「別跳進去」 看看這2檔記憶體
news.Content:
被動元件龍頭國巨7月營收再創歷史新高，帶動今（11日）股價強勢大漲逾 7%、收在617元並站上月線。專家提醒，國巨股價自456元低點強彈近200 元，目前市場仍處於籌碼清洗與資金輪動階段，如前兩天強勢的華邦電、南亞科今日即出現回檔；投資人切莫因短線大漲就誤以為主升段啟動而貿然追高。

國巨7月合併營收達 161.31 億元，月增 5%、年增 51.5%，連五個月刷新歷史新高紀錄；累計前七月營收987.53億元，年增32.5%。

資深分析師周代運在臉書發文指出，國巨這一波下殺至456元低點，引發原本樂觀的投資人陷入恐慌，在市場看空情緒籠罩下紛紛急著砍在底部。隨著恐慌賣壓釋放完畢、籌碼清洗乾淨，市場資金重新回流，推升股價一路強勢反彈重回600元大關。

周代運表示，盤面上前兩天強勢的華邦電、南亞科今天出現回檔，而經歷深度震盪、浮額清理到位的國巨則率先反彈，這並非單一族群的拉扯，而是多頭中段常見的資金調節。強勢股累積大量獲利盤後面臨主力調節，跌深且籌碼安定的個股自然吸引承接買盤。

他指出，被動元件過往幾輪週期走勢，幾乎都在重演人性循環：高點過度樂觀追價、低點全盤悲觀不敢布局，待股價拉回一大段後情緒又再次躁動，迫不及待想進場追高。說真的，這也是現在最擔心大家的地方。

周代運提醒，投資人切莫一看到盤面走強就急於追高，誤以為新一波主升段已全面啟動。他強調，自己對後市依然看多，先前建議在低點布局國巨，至今已累積大漲近200元，反彈到600元之上也不宜再追，至於大盤短線在45120點附近面臨壓力，波段布局可靜待中秋變盤，後續仍有機會挑戰53000點高點。

news.Title: 台股站上4萬5卻千檔下跌！法人揭「假熱鬧真輪動」：2大低基期族群接棒
news.Content:
台股11日上演典型「開低走高」行情，加權指數終場上漲191.96點、收45,120點，成交量縮至約8,700億元。不過，指數收紅背後卻出現明顯分歧，上市櫃下跌家數超過1,000家，市場再度陷入「指數有感、個股無感」的拉積盤格局。摩爾投顧分析師盤後指出，台積電與聯發科等權值股撐住大盤，但中小型股賣壓仍重，投資人普遍觀望美國即將公布的7月CPI數據。

6兆營收撐盤

上市櫃公司7月營收合計達5.79兆元，創單月歷史新高，連續5個月突破5兆元；營收創新高家數更首度突破200家，達206家。若加計較晚公布的大型金控，市場估計7月營收可望首度突破6兆元。

其中，鴻海(2317)7月營收9,465.1億元、台積電(2330)4,675.8億元，均創下亮眼成績，AI伺服器、先進製程與相關零組件需求仍是主要推力。

被動元件、ASIC接棒記憶體

相較於前期強勢的記憶體與CPO族群，11日資金明顯轉向被動元件，國巨*(2327)、華新科(2492)、禾伸堂(3026)領軍走強，信昌電(6173)等也同步表現。

市場關注的是AI伺服器需求持續推升MLCC等被動元件訂單，法人資料顯示，台廠訂單出貨比維持在相對高檔，反映供需結構改善。這波行情因此不只是跌深反彈，也有資金尋找低基期AI受惠股的意味。

AI主線並未熄火，而是出現族群輪動。創意(3443)11日亮燈漲停，市場聚焦Google TPU及CPU設計服務題材；相較之下，前期漲幅較大的記憶體族群出現整理，顯示資金開始從高位階題材轉向具訂單能見度的ASIC與設計服務。

分析師認為，現階段台股並非全面多頭，而是進入「權值股撐指數、資金做輪動」階段。基本面強勁提供大盤下檔支撐，但個股表現將更加分化，投資人應避免追逐短線急漲股，轉向營收、獲利與產業需求同步改善的標的。

CPI前觀望 震盪中汰弱留強

市場接下來仍將聚焦美國7月CPI，以及其對聯準會9月降息預期的影響。在數據公布前，台股量能收斂、震盪加劇並不意外。

此外，華爾街近期大幅增加Nasdaq期貨空單，也顯示全球資金對科技股短線波動仍有疑慮。不過法人普遍認為，AI供應鏈營收創高、企業獲利動能延續，台股中長線趨勢尚未改變。

整體來看，台股45,000點行情已進入「權值股撐指數、資金做輪動」的新階段。市場正從記憶體與光通訊等強勢族群，逐步轉向被動元件、ASIC與電力基礎設施等低基期AI受惠股。

在高效能運算、物聯網、車用及消費電子平台業績成長推升下，台積電2026年第2季營收與獲利續創歷史新高，季營收達402億美元，約新台幣1兆2703.8億元，歸屬母公司淨利7065.6億元，每股純益27.25元。

台積電董事會核准配發2026年第2季每股現金股利7元，配息基準日定為2026年12月16日，除息交易日為12月10日，自12月12日起至12月16日止停止普通股股票過戶，並於2027年1月7日發放。

台積電董事長魏哲家2026年7月持有台積電745萬2349股，將有5216萬元入袋。行政院國家發展基金管理會持有台積電16.537億股，估計有115.759億元入帳。

台積電創辦人張忠謀2018年6月退休前持有台積電1.25億股，他在退休後若未處分手中持股，估計將有約8.75億元入袋。

news.Title: 7月台股價量齊走弱　證交稅收斂至651億元
news.Content:
（中央社記者呂晏慈台北2026年8月11日電）財政部今天公布7月全國賦稅收入初步統計，受台股震盪劇烈影響，價量同步走弱，使得證券交易稅實徵淨額降至新台幣651億元，不過相較去年仍年增1.7倍；累計前7月證交稅實徵淨額3987億元，創同期新高。

財政部公布7月全國賦稅收入初步統計概況，7月實徵淨額2891億元，年減67%，主因去年所得稅結算申報及繳納期限延長，稅款遞延至7月，基期偏高所致。

財政部統計處副處長劉訓蓉表示，7月台股震盪劇烈，價量同步走弱，單日指數的漲跌點均創下歷史新高，月底指數收在43119.75點，較6月大跌3006點，為史上第2大月跌點，僅次於今年3月，跌幅6.5%。

劉訓蓉表示，7月台股呈現劇烈震盪格局，市場量能隨著指數大幅波動而明顯降溫，日均成交值為1兆1532億元，相較6月減少25.2%，但數值仍是歷年單月第3高，年增幅1.8倍。

她指出，由於股市成交值下滑，7月證交稅實徵淨額降至651億元，月減23.3%，年增1.7倍，為連續12個月正成長。

此外，今年前7月證交稅實徵淨額3987億元，年增2593億元，劉訓蓉說明，兩者均刷新歷年同期新高紀錄，年增幅為1.9倍，為87年以來同期新高。

劉訓蓉補充，截至今天為止，8月台股日均成交值為1兆784億元，較7月平均值稍微下滑。

其他呈現年增的稅目部分，7月包括營業稅、印花稅均創歷年單月新高，關稅、證交稅、期交稅、契稅則創同月新高。

營業稅7月實徵淨額1376億元，年增22.3%，主因內需穩定，加以資通與視聽產品、電子零組件等進口代徵稅額增加，惟出口暢旺，適用外銷零稅率營業人申請退稅亦增，抵銷部分增幅。

印花稅7月實徵淨額32億元，年增19.7%，主因銀行放款應稅憑證增加。

今年前7月總稅收實徵淨額2兆8767億元，為歷年同期新高，年增25%，其中包括關稅、營所稅、綜所稅、遺產稅、證交稅、期交稅、營業稅、房屋稅、印花稅、娛樂稅均創同期新高。

劉訓蓉說明，去年全年總稅收實徵淨額為3兆7879億元，預估後續若股市狀況沒有太大變化，今年全年總稅收實徵淨額將較去年稍微成長。

觀察各級政府賦稅收入概況，前7月中央政府賦稅收入實徵淨額1兆9177億元，占分配預算數122.1%，較去年同期增加13.5%。

劉訓蓉表示，雖然新版財政收支劃分法開始施行，營業稅劃歸中央政府比率大幅調降，減少2202億元、占比90.9%，惟證交稅、營所稅增加2593億元、1301億元，互抵後呈現上升。

news.Title: 外資連2買狂掃740億！ 網見第一名傻眼：買成這樣還綠的
news.Content:
台股今（11）日開低震盪，盤中買盤回籠，加權指數終場上漲191.96點，收在45120.72點，漲幅0.43%，成交值8690.16億元。三大法人同步站在買方，合計買超281.78億元，其中外資買超223.29億元，連續第2個交易日買超，本週2個交易日合計狂買740.70億元。

外資今日持續回補台股，買超金額達223.29億元，繼前一交易日買超517.41億元後，連續第2個交易日站在買方，短短兩個交易日累計買超達740.70億元，資金回流態勢相當明顯。

從外資買超個股來看，華邦電（2344）今日成為買超冠軍，單日大買3萬7871張；至上（8112）買超3萬3079張居次，中鋼（2002）買超2萬9246張，第一金（2892）也獲買超2萬3747張。此外，主動統一台股增長（00981A）買超1萬9816張、元大台灣50（0050）買超1萬8569張，南亞科（2408）買超1萬5172張，華新（1605）及台橡（2103）則分別買超1萬2065張、1萬1591張，群益台灣精選高息（00919）也買超1萬246張。

值得注意的是，華邦電雖然獲得外資大舉買進，股價表現卻與籌碼形成強烈反差，成為盤後網友熱議焦點。有網友看到華邦電登上外資買超第一名後直呼「買成這樣還綠的」，也有人留言「華邦電榜首，結果是綠色」，對於外資大買、股價卻未能同步上漲感到疑惑。

記憶體族群也成為討論焦點，南亞科同樣名列外資買超前10名，不過盤面上相關個股走勢分歧，網友接連發問「記憶體誰在賣？」、「大買的記憶體跌，大賣的被動元件漲」，顯示市場對記憶體族群短線籌碼仍有不同解讀。

另一方面，外資今日也大幅調節部分個股，其中友達（2409）遭賣超5萬6259張居冠，華航（2610）賣超2萬6705張，合庫金（5880）賣超2萬5723張，主動復華未來50（00991A）賣超2萬90張。金融股同樣出現調節，臺企銀（2834）遭賣超1萬8305張、兆豐金（2886）賣超1萬7172張、玉山金（2884）賣超9675張；群創（3481）、主動群益台灣強棒（00982A）及友訊（2332）也遭外資賣超。

盤面另一個有趣現象是，被動元件族群今日股價走強，但外資卻出現調節，網友因此討論外資是否正在進行族群輪動，有人甚至留言「小兒國巨賣成這樣還能漲7.68%」，認為外資籌碼動向與股價表現並非完全同步。

news.Title: Japan’s chip subsidies may swing $6.4 billion Sony bet
news.Content: Sony and TSMC are back in Kumamoto, this time as partners rather than neighbors, discussing a $6.4 billion image sensor plant on the same ground where Japan already spent billions rebuilding its chip industry. Five years ago, Tokyo lured TSMC to the prefecture with unprecedented state subsidies. Now Sony is the one asking Japan's government for help, and how much it gets could decide how big the project ultimately becomes. The basic terms of the Sony-TSMC deal Sony and TSMC are discussing a combined ¥1 trillion investment, worth about $6.4 billion , in a ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Sony and TSMC are discussing a $6.4 billion joint venture to build next-generation image sensors in Kumamoto, Japan, with mass production targeted for 2029.
• Sony would hold a 60% stake and TSMC 40% in the venture, which would supply sensors for Apple's iPhones and AI applications like robots and autonomous vehicles.
• The project's size is contingent on Japanese government subsidies, with Tokyo having previously provided significant support for TSMC's existing fabs in the region.
• This collaboration allows TSMC to share capital and process risk, aligning with Sony's pivot towards IP businesses and treating chip manufacturing as a shared bet.
news.Keywords: joint venture, image sensors, government subsidies, capital risk, manufacturing capacity

news.Content: Key Points Interested in Micron Technology, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better. news.Title: Arista Networks vs. Arm: Comparing Revenue Growth Trajectories for These Artificial Intelligence Companies
news.Content:
Arista Networks: A Pattern of Consistent Sequential Revenue Increases

Arista Networks (NYSE:ANET) primarily generates revenue by designing, promoting, and distributing advanced cloud networking hardware and software applications to large-scale enterprise customers and major internet service providers across global markets.

While introducing the new 7060XE7 Series networking hardware portfolio during June 2026, it generated a 40% net income margin and $1.1 billion in free cash flow for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Arm: Fluctuating Quarter-Over-Quarter Revenue Trends

Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) primarily generates revenue by conceptualizing, engineering, and licensing foundational central processing unit designs and related systems intellectual property to global technology manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers.

It became the subject of multiple federal securities fraud investigations during May 2026. It reported a 21% net income margin alongside $694.0 million in free cash flow for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

news.Title: Arm Stock Is Off 39% From Its High. Why This Could Be the Best Time to Buy.
news.Content:
After an impressive rally, Arm Holdings (ARM) has experienced a sharp correction, with its stock price falling 36.3% from its 52-week high. The decline has largely been driven by profit-taking following the stock's strong run, along with concerns about sluggish smartphone demand, which remains an important end market for the company.

However, a closer look at Arm's latest financial performance and long-term growth drivers suggests that the recent weakness represents an entry point. Arm Holdings continues to benefit from accelerating adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), expanding demand for its chip architecture across data centers, automotive applications, edge devices, and cloud infrastructure.

More News from Barchart

Don't Assume Micron Will Share SanDisk's Fate. Here's Why.

The Nvidia-SpaceX Deal Is Sending a Clear Signal on AI Dominance

A $72 Billion Reason to Buy Caterpillar Stock Now
